theorem bernoulliList_getLast (n : ℕ) :

name: BernoulliRegular.BernoulliFast.binomSum_eq
statement:
theorem binomSum_eq (bs : List ℚ) (m : ℕ) :
    binomSum bs m =
      ∑ k ∈ range bs.length, ↑(m.choose k) * bs.getD k 0

name: BernoulliRegular.BernoulliFast.binomSum_loop_eq
statement:
theorem binomSum_loop_eq (m : ℕ) (bs : List ℚ) (k : ℕ) (c acc : ℚ)
    (hc : c = ↑(m.choose k)) :
    binomSum.loop m bs k c acc =
      acc + ∑ j ∈ range bs.length, ↑(m.choose (k + j)) * bs.getD j 0

name: BernoulliRegular.BernoulliFast.cast_choose_mul_eq
statement:
theorem cast_choose_mul_eq (m k : ℕ) (hk : k < m) :
    (↑(m.choose (k + 1)) : ℚ) =
      ↑(m.choose k) * ((m : ℚ) - k) / ((k : ℚ) + 1)

name: BernoulliRegular.BernoulliFast.cast_choose_mul_eq_of_le

name: BernoulliRegular.BernoulliFast.eq_bernoulli_of_sum_eq

theorem eq_bernoulli_of_sum_eq (f : ℕ → ℚ)
    (hf : ∀ n, 1 ≤ n →
      (∑ k ∈ range n, ↑(n.choose k) * f k) = if n = 1 then 1 else 0) :
    ∀ n, f n = bernoulli n

name: ClassGroup.extensionMap_injective_iff
statement:
theorem extensionMap_injective_iff :
    Function.Injective (extensionMap A B) ↔
      ∀ I : (FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A))ˣ,
        ClassGroup.mk (FractionRing B)
            (Units.map (FractionalIdeal.extensionMap A B).toMonoidHom I) = 1 →
          ClassGroup.mk (FractionRing A) I = 1

name: ClassGroup.extensionMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extensionMap_mk (I : (FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A))ˣ) :
    extensionMap A B (ClassGroup.mk (FractionRing A) I) =
      ClassGroup.mk (FractionRing B)
        (Units.map (FractionalIdeal.extensionMap A B).toMonoidHom I)

name: ClassGroup.extensionMap_mk0
statement:
lemma extensionMap_mk0 (I : (Ideal A)⁰) :
    extensionMap A B (ClassGroup.mk0 I) =
      ClassGroup.mk0 ⟨I.1.map (algebraMap A B),
        mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr <|
          (Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective
            (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective A B)).not.mpr
          (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp I.2)⟩

name: ClassGroup.extensionMap_mk0'
statement:
theorem extensionMap_mk0' [IsDedekindDomain A] (I : (Ideal A)⁰) :
    extensionMap A B (ClassGroup.mk0 I) =
      ClassGroup.mk (FractionRing B) (Units.map (FractionalIdeal.extensionMap A B).toMonoidHom
        (FractionalIdeal.mk0 (FractionRing A) I))

name: ClassGroup.extensionMap_quotientMk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma extensionMap_quotientMk (α : (FractionalIdeal A⁰ (FractionRing A))ˣ) :
    extensionMap A B (QuotientGroup.mk α) =
      QuotientGroup.mk
        (Units.map (FractionalIdeal.extensionMap A B).toMonoidHom α)

name: FractionalIdeal.algebraMap_nonZeroDivisors_le
statement:
lemma algebraMap_nonZeroDivisors_le :
    A⁰ ≤ Submonoid.comap (algebraMap A B) B⁰

name: FractionalIdeal.extensionMap_spanSingleton
statement:
lemma extensionMap_spanSingleton (x : FractionRing A) :

name: BernoulliRegular.CyclotomicUnits.deletedConvolution_mul_deletedCharacter

    [Fintype (MulChar G ℂ)] [DecidableEq (MulChar G ℂ)]
    (ρ : NontrivChar G ≃ Nonidentity G) (q : G → ℂ) :
    deletedConvolutionMatrix (G := G) ρ q *
        deletedCharacterMatrix (G := G) ρ =
      deletedCharacterMatrix (G := G) ρ *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun χ : NontrivChar G ↦
          deletedFourierCoeff (G := G) q χ.val)

name: BernoulliRegular.CyclotomicUnits.det_deletedConvolutionMatrixAtReindexed_eq_charFactor_mul_prod
statement:
theorem det_deletedConvolutionMatrixAtReindexed_eq_charFactor_mul_prod

    (deletedConvolutionMatrixAtReindexed (G := G) h₀ q).det =

        ∏ χ : NontrivChar G, deletedFourierCoeff (G := G) q χ.val

name: BernoulliRegular.CyclotomicUnits.det_deletedConvolutionMatrixAtReindexed_eq_charFactor_mul_prod_erase
statement:
theorem det_deletedConvolutionMatrixAtReindexed_eq_charFactor_mul_prod_erase
    [DecidableEq G] [Fintype (MulChar G ℂ)] [DecidableEq (MulChar G ℂ)]
    (ρ : NontrivChar G ≃ Nonidentity G) (h₀ : G) (q : G → ℂ) :
    (deletedConvolutionMatrixAtReindexed (G := G) h₀ q).det =
      (∏ χ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (MulChar G ℂ)).erase 1, χ h₀) *
        ∏ χ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (MulChar G ℂ)).erase 1,
          deletedFourierCoeff (G := G) q χ

theorem det_deletedConvolutionMulMatrixAtReindexed_sq_eq_charFactor_mul_prod_sq
    [DecidableEq G] [Fintype (MulChar G ℂ)] [DecidableEq (MulChar G ℂ)]

name: BernoulliRegular.CyclotomicUnits.sum_nonidentity_deletedConvolution_mulChar
statement:
theorem sum_nonidentity_deletedConvolution_mulChar
    [DecidableEq G]
    (q : G → ℂ) (χ : MulChar G ℂ) (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (h : G) :
    ∑ k : Nonidentity G, (q (h * k.val⁻¹) - q h) * χ k.val =

name: BernoulliRegular.CyclotomicUnits.sum_subtype_ne_eq_sum_erase

theorem sum_subtype_ne_eq_sum_erase {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]

    ∑ x : {x : α // x ≠ a₀}, f x.val =

theorem finiteFieldExponent_pow [NeZero p] (zeta : kˣ) (hzeta : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta p)
    (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card k - 1) (x : kˣ) (n : ℕ) :
    finiteFieldExponent zeta hzeta hdiv (x ^ n) =
      n * finiteFieldExponent zeta hzeta hdiv x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.finiteFieldExponent_zeta_pow
statement:
theorem finiteFieldExponent_zeta_pow [Fact p.Prime] [NeZero p]
    {zeta : kˣ} (hzeta : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta p)
    (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card k - 1) {n : ℕ}
    (hpow : IsPrimitiveRoot (zeta ^ n) p) (x : kˣ) :
    (n : ZMod p) * finiteFieldExponent (zeta ^ n) hpow hdiv x =
      finiteFieldExponent zeta hzeta hdiv x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.finiteFieldUnit_eq_one_iff_isPow
statement:
theorem finiteFieldUnit_eq_one_iff_isPow [Fact p.Prime]
    (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card k - 1) (x : kˣ) :
    finiteFieldUnit hdiv x = 1 ↔ ∃ y : kˣ, x = y ^ p

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.finiteFieldUnit_mem_zpowers
statement:
theorem finiteFieldUnit_mem_zpowers [NeZero p] {zeta : kˣ} (hzeta : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta p)
    (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card k - 1) (x : kˣ) :
    finiteFieldUnit hdiv x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers zeta

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.finiteFieldUnit_mul
statement:
theorem finiteFieldUnit_mul (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card k - 1) (x y : kˣ) :
    finiteFieldUnit hdiv (x * y) = finiteFieldUnit hdiv x * finiteFieldUnit hdiv y

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.finiteFieldUnit_one
statement:
theorem finiteFieldUnit_one (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card k - 1) :
    finiteFieldUnit hdiv (1 : kˣ) = 1

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.finiteFieldUnit_pow
statement:
theorem finiteFieldUnit_pow (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card k - 1) (x : kˣ) (n : ℕ) :
    finiteFieldUnit hdiv (x ^ n) = (finiteFieldUnit hdiv x) ^ n

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.finiteFieldUnit_pow_eq_one
statement:
theorem finiteFieldUnit_pow_eq_one (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card k - 1) (x : kˣ) :

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.idealExponentOfPrimeSymbols_mul
statement:
theorem idealExponentOfPrimeSymbols_mul (chi : (q : Ideal R) → Prime q → ZMod p)
    {I J : Ideal R} (hI : I ≠ 0) (hJ : J ≠ 0) :
    idealExponentOfPrimeSymbols chi (I * J) =
      idealExponentOfPrimeSymbols chi I + idealExponentOfPrimeSymbols chi J

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.idealExponent_mul
statement:
theorem idealExponent_mul (chi : Ideal R → ZMod p)
    {I J : Ideal R} (hI : I ≠ 0) (hJ : J ≠ 0) :
    idealExponent chi (I * J) =
      idealExponent chi I + idealExponent chi J

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.isPow_iff_pow_card_div_eq_one
statement:
theorem isPow_iff_pow_card_div_eq_one {G : Type*} [CommGroup G]
    [Finite G] [IsCyclic G] {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∣ Nat.card G) (u : G) :
    (∃ v : G, u = v ^ p) ↔ u ^ (Nat.card G / p) = 1

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.primeExponent_mul
statement:
theorem primeExponent_mul {p : ℕ} [NeZero p] [Fintype (R ⧸ q)] (zeta_q : (R ⧸ q)ˣ)
    (hzeta_q : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_q p)
    (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card (R ⧸ q) - 1) {x y : R}
    (hx : x ∉ q) (hy : y ∉ q) (hxy : x * y ∉ q) :
    primeExponent q zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv (x * y) hxy =
      primeExponent q zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv x hx +
        primeExponent q zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv y hy

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.primeExponent_one
statement:
theorem primeExponent_one {p : ℕ} [NeZero p] [Fintype (R ⧸ q)] (zeta_q : (R ⧸ q)ˣ)
    (hzeta_q : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_q p)
    (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card (R ⧸ q) - 1) (h1 : (1 : R) ∉ q) :
    primeExponent q zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv (1 : R) h1 = 0

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.primeExponent_pow
statement:
theorem primeExponent_pow {p : ℕ} [NeZero p] [Fintype (R ⧸ q)] (zeta_q : (R ⧸ q)ˣ)
    (hzeta_q : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_q p)
    (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card (R ⧸ q) - 1) {x : R} (hx : x ∉ q)
    (n : ℕ) (hxn : x ^ n ∉ q) :
    primeExponent q zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv (x ^ n) hxn =
      n * primeExponent q zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv x hx

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.primeExponent_zeta_pow
statement:
theorem primeExponent_zeta_pow {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] [NeZero p] [Fintype (R ⧸ q)]
    {zeta_q : (R ⧸ q)ˣ} (hzeta_q : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_q p)
    (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card (R ⧸ q) - 1) {n : ℕ}
    (hpow : IsPrimitiveRoot (zeta_q ^ n) p) (α : R) (hα : α ∉ q) :
    (n : ZMod p) * primeExponent q (zeta_q ^ n) hpow hdiv α hα =
      primeExponent q zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv α hα

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.quotientUnitOfNotMem_mul
statement:
theorem quotientUnitOfNotMem_mul {x y : R} (hx : x ∉ q) (hy : y ∉ q)

      quotientUnitOfNotMem q x hx * quotientUnitOfNotMem q y hy

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.quotientUnitOfNotMem_one
statement:
theorem quotientUnitOfNotMem_one {h1 : (1 : R) ∉ q} :

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.quotientUnitOfNotMem_pow
statement:
theorem quotientUnitOfNotMem_pow {x : R} (hx : x ∉ q) (n : ℕ)
    (hxn : x ^ n ∉ q) :
    quotientUnitOfNotMem q (x ^ n) hxn = (quotientUnitOfNotMem q x hx) ^ n

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.ResidueSymbol.PowerResidue.zeta_pow_finiteFieldExponent_val
statement:
theorem zeta_pow_finiteFieldExponent_val [NeZero p]
    {zeta : kˣ} (hzeta : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta p)

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.finiteFieldExponent_one

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.residueMulChar_apply_unit
statement:
theorem residueMulChar_apply_unit [NeZero p]
    (zeta_q : kˣ) (hzeta_q : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_q p)

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.residueMulChar_pow_eq_one
statement:
theorem residueMulChar_pow_eq_one [NeZero p]

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.exists_finiteFieldUnit_ne_one
statement:
theorem exists_finiteFieldUnit_ne_one

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.finiteFieldExponent_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finiteFieldExponent_eq_zero_iff

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.residueGaussSum_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem residueGaussSum_def [NeZero p]
    (zeta_q : kˣ) (hzeta_q : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_q p)
    (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card k - 1)
    (zeta_R : R'ˣ) (hzeta_R : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_R p)
    (psi_q : AddChar k R') :
    residueGaussSum zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv zeta_R hzeta_R psi_q =
      gaussSum (residueMulChar zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv zeta_R hzeta_R) psi_q

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.residueGaussSum_mul_inv_eq_card
statement:
theorem residueGaussSum_mul_inv_eq_card [NeZero p]
    (zeta_q : kˣ) (hzeta_q : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_q p)
    (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card k - 1)
    (zeta_R : R'ˣ) (hzeta_R : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_R p)
    {psi_q : AddChar k R'} (hpsi : psi_q.IsPrimitive)
    (hχ : residueMulChar zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv zeta_R hzeta_R ≠ 1) :
    residueGaussSum zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv zeta_R hzeta_R psi_q *
      gaussSum (residueMulChar zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv zeta_R hzeta_R)⁻¹ psi_q⁻¹ =
        Fintype.card k

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.residueGaussSum_ringHomComp
statement:
theorem residueGaussSum_ringHomComp [NeZero p]
    {R'' : Type*} [CommRing R'']
    (zeta_q : kˣ) (hzeta_q : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_q p)
    (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card k - 1)
    (zeta_R : R'ˣ) (hzeta_R : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_R p)
    (psi_q : AddChar k R') (σ : R' →+* R'') :
    σ (residueGaussSum zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv zeta_R hzeta_R psi_q) =
      gaussSum
        ((residueMulChar zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv zeta_R hzeta_R).ringHomComp σ)

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.residueMulChar_apply_ne_one_of_finiteFieldUnit_ne_one

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.gaussSum_pow_invariant_of_pow_eq_one

theorem gaussSum_pow_invariant_of_pow_eq_one

theorem orderOf_residueMulChar

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.residueGaussSum_mul_gaussSum_pow_p_sub_one
statement:
theorem residueGaussSum_mul_gaussSum_pow_p_sub_one
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k]

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.residueGaussSum_pow_p_eq_prod_jacobiSum
statement:
theorem residueGaussSum_pow_p_eq_prod_jacobiSum
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k]
    {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] [IsDomain R']
    {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (zeta_q : kˣ) (hzeta_q : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_q p)
    (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card k - 1)
    (zeta_R : R'ˣ) (hzeta_R : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_R p)
    {psi_q : AddChar k R'} (hpsi : psi_q.IsPrimitive) :
    (residueGaussSum zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv zeta_R hzeta_R psi_q) ^ p =
      (residueMulChar zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv zeta_R hzeta_R) (-1) *
        Fintype.card k *
        ∏ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (p - 1),
          jacobiSum (residueMulChar zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv zeta_R hzeta_R)
            ((residueMulChar zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv zeta_R hzeta_R) ^ i)

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.residueGaussSum_pow_p_invariant
statement:
theorem residueGaussSum_pow_p_invariant
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k]

    (hσψ : σ.toMonoidHom.compAddChar psi_q = AddChar.mulShift psi_q a) :

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.residueGaussSum_pow_p_isIntegral
statement:
theorem residueGaussSum_pow_p_isIntegral

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.residueGaussSum_pow_p_mem_closure
statement:
theorem residueGaussSum_pow_p_mem_closure
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k]

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.residueGaussSum_pow_p_mul_pow_p_sub_one_eq_card_pow
statement:
theorem residueGaussSum_pow_p_mul_pow_p_sub_one_eq_card_pow
    {k : Type*} [Field k] [Fintype k]
    {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] [IsDomain R']
    {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (zeta_q : kˣ) (hzeta_q : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_q p)
    (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card k - 1)
    (zeta_R : R'ˣ) (hzeta_R : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_R p)
    {psi_q : AddChar k R'} (hpsi : psi_q.IsPrimitive) :
    (residueGaussSum zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv zeta_R hzeta_R psi_q) ^ p *
        (gaussSum
          ((residueMulChar zeta_q hzeta_q hdiv zeta_R hzeta_R) ^ (p - 1)) psi_q) ^ p =
      ((Fintype.card k : R')) ^ p

statement:
theorem stickelberger_qadic_ord_at_prime_of_leading_congruence
    (S : StickelbergerSetup p k R') {ℓ : ℕ} (a : ℕ) {Q : Ideal R'} {lead : R'}
    (h_lead_mem :
      lead ∈ Q ^ digitSum ℓ (a * ((Fintype.card k - 1) / p)))
    (h_lead_not_mem_succ :
      lead ∉ Q ^ (digitSum ℓ (a * ((Fintype.card k - 1) / p)) + 1))
    (h_congr :
      gaussSum (S.residueChar ^ a) S.psi_q - lead ∈
        Q ^ (digitSum ℓ (a * ((Fintype.card k - 1) / p)) + 1)) :
    gaussSum (S.residueChar ^ a) S.psi_q ∈
        Q ^ digitSum ℓ (a * ((Fintype.card k - 1) / p)) ∧
      gaussSum (S.residueChar ^ a) S.psi_q ∉
        Q ^ (digitSum ℓ (a * ((Fintype.card k - 1) / p)) + 1)

statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkFromTrace_psi
    (hℓ_ne_p : ℓ ≠ p)
    (f : ℕ) (card_k : Fintype.card k = ℓ ^ f)
    (zeta_k : kˣ) (hzeta_k : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_k p)
    (hdiv : p ∣ Fintype.card k - 1)
    (zeta_p : R'ˣ) (hzeta_p : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_p p)
    (zeta_p_int : 𝓞 R')
    (zeta_p_int_spec : algebraMap (𝓞 R') R' zeta_p_int = (zeta_p : R'ˣ))
    (zeta_ell : R') (hzeta_ell : IsPrimitiveRoot zeta_ell ℓ)
    (zeta_ell_int : 𝓞 R')
    (zeta_ell_int_spec : algebraMap (𝓞 R') R' zeta_ell_int = zeta_ell)
    (π : 𝓞 R') (hπ : π = zeta_ell_int - 1)
    (Q : Ideal (𝓞 R')) (hQ_prime : Q.IsPrime) (hQ : (ℓ : 𝓞 R') ∈ Q)
    (residueMap : 𝓞 R' →+* k)
    (residueMap_surjective : Function.Surjective residueMap)
    (residueMap_ker : RingHom.ker residueMap = Q)
    (zeta_p_int_residue : residueMap zeta_p_int = (zeta_k : k))
    (h_ringChar : ringChar k = ℓ) :
    (mkFromTrace (K := K) hℓ_ne_p f card_k zeta_k hzeta_k hdiv zeta_p hzeta_p
        zeta_p_int zeta_p_int_spec zeta_ell hzeta_ell zeta_ell_int
        zeta_ell_int_spec π hπ Q hQ_prime hQ residueMap residueMap_surjective
        residueMap_ker zeta_p_int_residue h_ringChar).psi =
      psiTraceForm ℓ k R' hzeta_ell

theorem mapTo_subst {r : ℕ} {A : Type*} [CommRing A]
    (φ : rIntegralRatSubring r →+* A) {F G : PowerSeries ℚ}
    (hF : IsRIntegralPS r F) (hG : IsRIntegralPS r G)
    (hG0 : PowerSeries.constantCoeff G = 0) :
    (hF.subst hG hG0).mapTo φ =
      PowerSeries.subst (hG.mapTo φ) (hF.mapTo φ)

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.DieudonneDwork.IsRIntegralPS.pow_r_sub_subst_X_pow_r_in_r_smul

    ∃ q : ℚ, IsRIntegralRat r q ∧
      (PowerSeries.coeff (R := ℚ) n)
        (F ^ r - PowerSeries.subst (PowerSeries.X ^ r) F) = (r : ℚ) * q

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.FiniteLogFormal.coeff_log_subst_add_add_mul_scaled
statement:
theorem coeff_log_subst_add_add_mul_scaled [IsAddTorsionFree A] (x y : A) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n
        (PowerSeries.subst
          (PowerSeries.X * PowerSeries.C x + PowerSeries.X * PowerSeries.C y +
            PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * PowerSeries.C (x * y))
          (PowerSeries.log A)) =
      PowerSeries.coeff n
          (PowerSeries.subst (PowerSeries.X * PowerSeries.C x) (PowerSeries.log A)) +
        PowerSeries.coeff n
          (PowerSeries.subst (PowerSeries.X * PowerSeries.C y) (PowerSeries.log A))

statement:
theorem log_subst_add_add_mul_scaled [IsAddTorsionFree A] (x y : A) :
    PowerSeries.subst
        (PowerSeries.X * PowerSeries.C x + PowerSeries.X * PowerSeries.C y +
          PowerSeries.X ^ 2 * PowerSeries.C (x * y))
        (PowerSeries.log A) =
      PowerSeries.subst (PowerSeries.X * PowerSeries.C x) (PowerSeries.log A) +
        PowerSeries.subst (PowerSeries.X * PowerSeries.C y) (PowerSeries.log A)

    PowerSeries.subst

            (1 + PowerSeries.X * PowerSeries.C y) - 1)
        (PowerSeries.log A) =
      PowerSeries.subst (PowerSeries.X * PowerSeries.C x) (PowerSeries.log A) +
        PowerSeries.subst (PowerSeries.X * PowerSeries.C y) (PowerSeries.log A)

statement:
theorem algebraMap_trace_pow_eq_traceSum_pow
    {K L : Type*} [Field K] [Field L] [Finite L] [Algebra K L]
    {ℓ f : ℕ} (h_card_K : Nat.card K = ℓ) (h_finrank : Module.finrank K L = f)
    (x : L) (n : ℕ) :
    algebraMap K L (Algebra.trace K L x) ^ n = (traceSum ℓ f x) ^ n

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.traceSum_pow_eq_sum_multinomial
statement:
theorem traceSum_pow_eq_sum_multinomial (ℓ f : ℕ) (x : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (traceSum ℓ f x) ^ n =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.piAntidiag (Finset.range f) n,
        Nat.multinomial (Finset.range f) k *
          ∏ i ∈ Finset.range f, (x ^ (ℓ ^ i)) ^ k i

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.traceSum_pow_eq_sum_multinomial'
statement:
theorem traceSum_pow_eq_sum_multinomial' (ℓ f : ℕ) (x : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (traceSum ℓ f x) ^ n =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.piAntidiag (Finset.range f) n,
        Nat.multinomial (Finset.range f) k *
          x ^ (∑ i ∈ Finset.range f, k i * ℓ ^ i)

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.traceSum_succ
statement:
theorem traceSum_succ (ℓ f : ℕ) (x : R) :
    traceSum ℓ (f + 1) x = traceSum ℓ f x + x ^ (ℓ ^ f)

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.traceSum_zero_arg

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.TraceFormStickelbergerSetup.algebraMap_scaled_trace_pow_eq_sum_multinomial
statement:
theorem algebraMap_scaled_trace_pow_eq_sum_multinomial
    (x : k) (n : ℕ) :
    algebraMap (ZMod ℓ) k
        (Algebra.trace (ZMod ℓ) k ((S.traceScale : k) * x)) ^ n =
      ∑ ks ∈ Finset.piAntidiag (Finset.range S.f) n,
        (Nat.multinomial (Finset.range S.f) ks : k) *
          (S.traceScale : k) ^ traceMultiIndexExponent ℓ S.f ks *
          x ^ traceMultiIndexExponent ℓ S.f ks

statement:
theorem traceCharacterChooseSumRec_mul_factorial_eq_descFactorialSum
    (a n : ℕ) :
    S.traceCharacterChooseSumRec a n * (Nat.factorial n : 𝓞 R') =
      ∑ x : k, (S.residueCharInt ^ (p - a)) x *
        (Nat.descFactorial
          (Algebra.trace (ZMod ℓ) k ((S.traceScale : k) * x)).val n : 𝓞 R')

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.TraceFormStickelbergerSetup.trace_finrank_eq_f
statement: theorem trace_finrank_eq_f : Module.finrank (ZMod ℓ) k = S.f

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.TraceFormStickelbergerSetup.unitSum_scaled_trace_pow_eq_sum_multinomial
statement:
theorem unitSum_scaled_trace_pow_eq_sum_multinomial
    (A n : ℕ) :
    (∑ x : kˣ,
        (x : k) ^ A *
          algebraMap (ZMod ℓ) k
            (Algebra.trace (ZMod ℓ) k ((S.traceScale : k) * (x : k))) ^ n) =
      ∑ ks ∈ Finset.piAntidiag (Finset.range S.f) n,
        ((Nat.multinomial (Finset.range S.f) ks : k) *
          (S.traceScale : k) ^ traceMultiIndexExponent ℓ S.f ks) *
          ∑ x : kˣ, (x : k) ^ (A + traceMultiIndexExponent ℓ S.f ks)

name: BernoulliRegular.Furtwaengler.traceSum_mul_pow_eq_sum_multinomial
statement:
theorem traceSum_mul_pow_eq_sum_multinomial
    (ℓ f : ℕ) (c x : R) (n : ℕ) :
    (traceSum ℓ f (c * x)) ^ n =
      ∑ ks ∈ Finset.piAntidiag (Finset.range f) n,
        (Nat.multinomial (Finset.range f) ks : R) *
          c ^ traceMultiIndexExponent ℓ f ks *
          x ^ traceMultiIndexExponent ℓ f ks

statement:
theorem eq_unitPair_mul_principalPair_of_ideal_eq_principal
    (s : SingularPair R K p) {gamma : Kˣ}
    (hgamma : toPrincipalIdeal R K gamma = ideal s) :
    s =
      unitPair (R := R) (K := K) p
        ⟨generator s / gamma ^ p, by
          change toPrincipalIdeal R K (generator s / gamma ^ p) = 1
          rw [map_div, map_pow, hgamma, principal_eq_ideal_pow (R := R) (K := K) s]
          simp⟩ *
        principalPair (R := R) (K := K) p gamma

    (ρM : Delta p →* M ≃ₗ[ZMod p] M)

    (f : M →ₗ[ZMod p] N)
    (hf : ∀ (a : Delta p) (x : M), f (ρM a x) = ρN a (f x))

theorem projection_apply

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.CharacterProjection.projection_commute

theorem projection_commute
    (ρM : Delta p →* M ≃ₗ[ZMod p] M)
    (ρN : Delta p →* N ≃ₗ[ZMod p] N)
    (f : M →ₗ[ZMod p] N)
    (hf : ∀ (a : Delta p) (x : M), f (ρM a x) = ρN a (f x))

theorem elementaryQuotient_nontrivial_of_torsionBySubgroup_nontrivial

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.quotient_range_nontrivial_iff_ker_nontrivial
statement:
theorem quotient_range_nontrivial_iff_ker_nontrivial

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.torsionBySubgroup_nontrivial_of_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial
statement:
theorem torsionBySubgroup_nontrivial_of_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ElementaryQuotientComponent.elementaryComponentNontrivial_iff_exists_ne_zero_mem
statement:
theorem elementaryComponentNontrivial_iff_exists_ne_zero_mem [NeZero p]
    (i : ℕ) (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)) :
    ElementaryComponentNontrivial (p := p) i ρ ↔
      ∃ x : ElementaryQuotient A p,
        x ≠ 0 ∧ x ∈ elementaryComponent (p := p) i ρ

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ElementaryQuotientComponent.elementaryComponentNontrivial_of_exists_ne_zero_mem
statement:
theorem elementaryComponentNontrivial_of_exists_ne_zero_mem [NeZero p]
    {i : ℕ} {ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)}
    (h : ∃ x : ElementaryQuotient A p,
      x ≠ 0 ∧ x ∈ elementaryComponent (p := p) i ρ) :
    ElementaryComponentNontrivial (p := p) i ρ

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ElementaryQuotientComponent.elementaryComponent_eq_range_projection
statement:
theorem elementaryComponent_eq_range_projection [NeZero p]
    (i : ℕ) (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)) :
    elementaryComponent (p := p) i ρ =
      LinearMap.range (elementaryProjection (p := p) i ρ)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ElementaryQuotientComponent.elementaryQuotientAction_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem elementaryQuotientAction_mk [NeZero p]
    (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A))
    (d : CharacterProjection.Delta p) (x : A) :
    elementaryQuotientAction (p := p) ρ d
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk x : ElementaryQuotient A p) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk ((Multiplicative.toAdd (ρ d)) x)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ElementaryQuotientComponent.elementaryQuotientAction_quotientMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem elementaryQuotientAction_quotientMap [NeZero p]
    (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A))
    (d : CharacterProjection.Delta p) (x : A) :
    elementaryQuotientAction (p := p) ρ d (quotientMap A p x) =
      quotientMap A p ((Multiplicative.toAdd (ρ d)) x)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ElementaryQuotientComponent.exists_ne_zero_mem_elementaryComponent
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_mem_elementaryComponent [NeZero p]
    {i : ℕ} {ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)}
    (h : ElementaryComponentNontrivial (p := p) i ρ) :
    ∃ x : ElementaryQuotient A p,
      x ≠ 0 ∧ x ∈ elementaryComponent (p := p) i ρ

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ElementaryQuotientComponent.mem_elementaryComponent_iff_exists
statement:
theorem mem_elementaryComponent_iff_exists [NeZero p]
    {i : ℕ} {ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)}
    {x : ElementaryQuotient A p} :
    x ∈ elementaryComponent (p := p) i ρ ↔
      ∃ y : ElementaryQuotient A p,
        elementaryProjection (p := p) i ρ y = x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ElementaryQuotientComponent.multiplesSubgroup_le_comap_addEquiv
statement:
theorem multiplesSubgroup_le_comap_addEquiv
    (p : ℕ) (e : A ≃+ A) :
    multiplesSubgroup A p ≤
      (multiplesSubgroup A p).comap e.toAddMonoidHom

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ElementaryQuotientComponent.quotientAddEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientAddEquiv_mk (p : ℕ) (e : A ≃+ A) (x : A) :
    quotientAddEquiv p e
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk x : ElementaryQuotient A p) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (e x)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ElementaryQuotientComponent.quotientLinearEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientLinearEquiv_mk (p : ℕ) (e : A ≃+ A) (x : A) :
    quotientLinearEquiv p e
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk x : ElementaryQuotient A p) =
      QuotientAddGroup.mk (e x)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ElementaryQuotientComponent.quotientLinearEquiv_quotientMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientLinearEquiv_quotientMap (p : ℕ) (e : A ≃+ A) (x : A) :
    quotientLinearEquiv p e (quotientMap A p x) =
      quotientMap A p (e x)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ElementaryQuotientComponent.quotientMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientMap_apply (p : ℕ) (x : A) :
    quotientMap A p x = (QuotientAddGroup.mk x : ElementaryQuotient A p)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ElementaryQuotientComponent.quotientMap_surjective
statement:
theorem quotientMap_surjective (p : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (quotientMap A p)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ElementaryQuotientComponent.zmod_smul_eq_val_nsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zmod_smul_eq_val_nsmul [NeZero p]
    (a : ZMod p) (x : ElementaryQuotient A p) :
    a • x = a.val • x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ProjectedFiniteComparison.characterProjection_range_ne_bot_of_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial_zmod
statement:
theorem characterProjection_range_ne_bot_of_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial_zmod
    (i : ℕ) (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* W ≃ₗ[ZMod p] W)
    (hV :
      Nontrivial
        (elementaryQuotient
          (LinearMap.range
            (CharacterProjection.characterProjection (p := p) i ρ)) p)) :
    LinearMap.range
        (CharacterProjection.characterProjection (p := p) i ρ) ≠ ⊥

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ProjectedFiniteComparison.characterProjection_range_nontrivial_of_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial_zmod
statement:
theorem characterProjection_range_nontrivial_of_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial_zmod
    (i : ℕ) (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* W ≃ₗ[ZMod p] W)
    (hV :
      Nontrivial
        (elementaryQuotient
          (LinearMap.range
            (CharacterProjection.characterProjection (p := p) i ρ)) p)) :
    Nontrivial
      (LinearMap.range
        (CharacterProjection.characterProjection (p := p) i ρ))

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ProjectedFiniteComparison.endomorphismRange_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial_iff_torsion_nontrivial
statement:
theorem endomorphismRange_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial_iff_torsion_nontrivial
    (e : A →+ A) (n : ℕ) :
    Nontrivial (elementaryQuotient e.range n) ↔
      Nontrivial (torsionBySubgroup e.range n)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ProjectedFiniteComparison.linearRange_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial_iff_torsion_nontrivial
statement:
theorem linearRange_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial_iff_torsion_nontrivial
    (e : M →ₗ[R] M) (n : ℕ) :
    Nontrivial (elementaryQuotient (LinearMap.range e) n) ↔
      Nontrivial (torsionBySubgroup (LinearMap.range e) n)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ProjectedFiniteComparison.linearRange_ne_bot_of_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial_zmod
statement:
theorem linearRange_ne_bot_of_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial_zmod
    (e : W →ₗ[ZMod p] W)
    (hV : Nontrivial (elementaryQuotient (LinearMap.range e) p)) :
    LinearMap.range e ≠ ⊥

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ProjectedFiniteComparison.linearRange_nontrivial_of_torsion_nontrivial_zmod
statement:
theorem linearRange_nontrivial_of_torsion_nontrivial_zmod
    (e : W →ₗ[ZMod p] W) :
    Nontrivial (torsionBySubgroup (LinearMap.range e) p) →
      Nontrivial (LinearMap.range e)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ProjectedFiniteComparison.linearRange_torsionBySubgroup_eq_top_zmod
statement:
theorem linearRange_torsionBySubgroup_eq_top_zmod
    (e : W →ₗ[ZMod p] W) :
    torsionBySubgroup (LinearMap.range e) p = ⊤

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ProjectedFiniteComparison.torsionBySubgroup_eq_top_of_zmodModule
statement:
theorem torsionBySubgroup_eq_top_of_zmodModule :
    torsionBySubgroup V p = ⊤

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ProjectedFiniteComparison.torsion_nontrivial_of_endomorphismRange_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial
statement:
theorem torsion_nontrivial_of_endomorphismRange_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial
    (e : A →+ A) {n : ℕ} :
    Nontrivial (elementaryQuotient e.range n) →
      Nontrivial (torsionBySubgroup e.range n)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ProjectedFiniteComparison.torsion_nontrivial_of_linearRange_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial
statement:
theorem torsion_nontrivial_of_linearRange_elementaryQuotient_nontrivial
    (e : M →ₗ[R] M) {n : ℕ} :
    Nontrivial (elementaryQuotient (LinearMap.range e) n) →
      Nontrivial (torsionBySubgroup (LinearMap.range e) n)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ProjectedFiniteComparison.torsion_nontrivial_of_linearRange_nontrivial_zmod
statement:
theorem torsion_nontrivial_of_linearRange_nontrivial_zmod
    (e : W →ₗ[ZMod p] W) :
    Nontrivial (LinearMap.range e) →
      Nontrivial (torsionBySubgroup (LinearMap.range e) p)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.TorsionComponent.coe_zmod_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_zmod_smul [NeZero p] (a : ZMod p) (x : PTorsion A p) :
    ((a • x : PTorsion A p) : A) = a.val • (x : A)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.TorsionComponent.exists_ne_zero_mem_torsionComponent
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_mem_torsionComponent [NeZero p]
    {i : ℕ} {ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)}
    (h : TorsionComponentNontrivial (p := p) i ρ) :
    ∃ x : PTorsion A p,
      x ≠ 0 ∧ x ∈ torsionComponent (p := p) i ρ

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.TorsionComponent.mem_torsionComponent_iff_exists
statement:
theorem mem_torsionComponent_iff_exists [NeZero p]
    {i : ℕ} {ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)}
    {x : PTorsion A p} :
    x ∈ torsionComponent (p := p) i ρ ↔
      ∃ y : PTorsion A p,
        torsionProjection (p := p) i ρ y = x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.TorsionComponent.torsionAction_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem torsionAction_apply_coe [NeZero p]
    (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A))
    (d : CharacterProjection.Delta p) (x : PTorsion A p) :
    ((torsionAction (p := p) ρ d x : PTorsion A p) : A) =
      (Multiplicative.toAdd (ρ d)) x.1

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.TorsionComponent.torsionAddEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem torsionAddEquiv_apply_coe (p : ℕ) (e : A ≃+ A) (x : PTorsion A p) :
    ((torsionAddEquiv p e x : PTorsion A p) : A) = e x.1

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.TorsionComponent.torsionComponentNontrivial_iff_exists_ne_zero_mem
statement:
theorem torsionComponentNontrivial_iff_exists_ne_zero_mem [NeZero p]
    (i : ℕ) (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)) :
    TorsionComponentNontrivial (p := p) i ρ ↔
      ∃ x : PTorsion A p,
        x ≠ 0 ∧ x ∈ torsionComponent (p := p) i ρ

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.TorsionComponent.torsionComponentNontrivial_of_exists_ne_zero_mem
statement:
theorem torsionComponentNontrivial_of_exists_ne_zero_mem [NeZero p]
    {i : ℕ} {ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)}
    (h : ∃ x : PTorsion A p,
      x ≠ 0 ∧ x ∈ torsionComponent (p := p) i ρ) :
    TorsionComponentNontrivial (p := p) i ρ

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.TorsionComponent.torsionComponent_eq_range_projection
statement:
theorem torsionComponent_eq_range_projection [NeZero p]
    (i : ℕ) (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)) :
    torsionComponent (p := p) i ρ =
      LinearMap.range (torsionProjection (p := p) i ρ)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.TorsionComponent.torsionLinearEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem torsionLinearEquiv_apply_coe [NeZero p]
    (e : A ≃+ A) (x : PTorsion A p) :
    ((torsionLinearEquiv (p := p) e x : PTorsion A p) : A) = e x.1

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ProjectedSubgroupComparison.subgroupTorsionToTorsion_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subgroupTorsionToTorsion_apply_coe
    (B : AddSubgroup A) (p : ℕ) (x : torsionBySubgroup B p) :
    ((subgroupTorsionToTorsion B p x : torsionBySubgroup A p) : A) =
      (x.1 : A)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.ProjectedSubgroupComparison.torsionComponentNontrivial_of_projectedSubgroup
statement:
theorem torsionComponentNontrivial_of_projectedSubgroup
    [NeZero p] (i : ℕ) (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A))
    (B : AddSubgroup A) [Finite B]
    (hquot : Nontrivial (elementaryQuotient B p))
    (hmem : ∀ x : torsionBySubgroup B p,
      subgroupTorsionToTorsion B p x ∈ torsionComponent (p := p) i ρ) :
    TorsionComponentNontrivial (p := p) i ρ

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.IntegralCharacterProjection.integralProjection_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem integralProjection_apply
    (i : ℕ) (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)) (x : A) :
    integralProjection (p := p) i ρ x =
      ∑ d : CharacterProjection.Delta p,
        (CharacterProjection.characterProjectionCoefficient (p := p) i d).val •
          (Multiplicative.toAdd (ρ d)) x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.IntegralCharacterProjection.quotientMap_integralProjection
statement:
theorem quotientMap_integralProjection
    (i : ℕ) (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)) (x : A) :
    quotientMap A p (integralProjection (p := p) i ρ x) =
      elementaryProjection (p := p) i ρ (quotientMap A p x)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.IntegralCharacterProjection.torsionProjection_apply_coe
statement:
theorem torsionProjection_apply_coe
    (i : ℕ) (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A))
    (x : PTorsion A p) :
    ((torsionProjection (p := p) i ρ x : PTorsion A p) : A) =
      integralProjection (p := p) i ρ x.1

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.CharacterProjection.characterProjectionCoefficient_mul_pow
statement:
theorem characterProjectionCoefficient_mul_pow
    (i : ℕ) (a : Delta p) :
    characterProjectionCoefficient (p := p) i a * ((a : ZMod p) ^ i) =
      (Fintype.card (Delta p) : ZMod p)⁻¹

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.CharacterProjection.characterProjection_apply_characterProjection
statement:
theorem characterProjection_apply_characterProjection
    (hcard : IsUnit (Fintype.card (Delta p) : ZMod p))
    (i : ℕ) (ρ : Delta p →* M ≃ₗ[ZMod p] M) (x : M) :
    characterProjection (p := p) i ρ
        (characterProjection (p := p) i ρ x) =
      characterProjection (p := p) i ρ x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.CharacterProjection.characterProjection_apply_eq_self_of_mem_range
statement:
theorem characterProjection_apply_eq_self_of_mem_range
    (hcard : IsUnit (Fintype.card (Delta p) : ZMod p))
    (i : ℕ) (ρ : Delta p →* M ≃ₗ[ZMod p] M)
    {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range (characterProjection (p := p) i ρ)) :
    characterProjection (p := p) i ρ x = x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.CharacterProjection.mem_characterProjection_range_of_forall_apply_eq_smul
statement:
theorem mem_characterProjection_range_of_forall_apply_eq_smul
    (hcard : IsUnit (Fintype.card (Delta p) : ZMod p))
    (i : ℕ) (ρ : Delta p →* M ≃ₗ[ZMod p] M)
    {x : M}
    (hx : ∀ a : Delta p, ρ a x = ((a : ZMod p) ^ i) • x) :
    x ∈ LinearMap.range (characterProjection (p := p) i ρ)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.SingularPair.PrincipalIdealPreservingEquiv.classGroupEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem classGroupEquiv_mk (I : (FractionalIdeal R⁰ K)ˣ) :
    A.classGroupEquiv (ClassGroup.mk (R := R) (K := K) I) =
      ClassGroup.mk (R := R) (K := K) (A.idealEquiv I)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.SingularPair.PrincipalIdealPreservingEquiv.classGroupPTorsionEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem classGroupPTorsionEquiv_apply_coe (p : ℕ)
    (c : classGroupPTorsion (R := R) p) :
    (A.classGroupPTorsionEquiv p c : ClassGroup R) =
      A.classGroupEquiv c.1

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.SingularPair.PrincipalIdealPreservingEquiv.classMapToPTorsion_equivariant
statement:
theorem classMapToPTorsion_equivariant (p : ℕ) (s : SingularPair R K p) :
    A.classGroupPTorsionEquiv p
        (classMapToPTorsion (R := R) (K := K) p s) =
      classMapToPTorsion (R := R) (K := K) p (A.singularPairEquiv p s)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.SingularPair.PrincipalIdealPreservingEquiv.fractionalUnitEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fractionalUnitEquiv_apply_coe
    (u : fractionalUnitSubgroup (R := R) (K := K)) :
    (A.fractionalUnitEquiv u : Kˣ) = A.unitEquiv u.1

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.SingularPair.PrincipalIdealPreservingEquiv.map_principalPairSubgroup
statement:
theorem map_principalPairSubgroup (p : ℕ) :
    (principalPairSubgroup (R := R) (K := K) p).map (A.singularPairEquiv p) =
      principalPairSubgroup (R := R) (K := K) p

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.SingularPair.PrincipalIdealPreservingEquiv.map_principalSubgroup
statement:
theorem map_principalSubgroup :
    (toPrincipalIdeal R K).range.map A.idealEquiv =
      (toPrincipalIdeal R K).range

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.SingularPair.PrincipalIdealPreservingEquiv.singularGroupClassMapToPTorsion_equivariant
statement:
theorem singularGroupClassMapToPTorsion_equivariant (p : ℕ)
    (x : SingularGroup (R := R) (K := K) p) :
    A.classGroupPTorsionEquiv p
        (singularGroupClassMapToPTorsion (R := R) (K := K) p x) =
      singularGroupClassMapToPTorsion (R := R) (K := K) p
        (A.singularGroupEquiv p x)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.SingularPair.PrincipalIdealPreservingEquiv.singularGroupEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem singularGroupEquiv_mk (p : ℕ) (s : SingularPair R K p) :
    A.singularGroupEquiv p
      (QuotientGroup.mk s : SingularGroup (R := R) (K := K) p) =
      (QuotientGroup.mk (A.singularPairEquiv p s) :
        SingularGroup (R := R) (K := K) p)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.SingularPair.PrincipalIdealPreservingEquiv.singularPairEquiv_generator
statement:
@[simp]
theorem singularPairEquiv_generator (p : ℕ) (s : SingularPair R K p) :
    generator (A.singularPairEquiv p s) = A.unitEquiv (generator s)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.SingularPair.PrincipalIdealPreservingEquiv.singularPairEquiv_ideal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem singularPairEquiv_ideal (p : ℕ) (s : SingularPair R K p) :
    ideal (A.singularPairEquiv p s) = A.idealEquiv (ideal s)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.SingularPair.PrincipalIdealPreservingEquiv.singularPairEquiv_principalPair
statement:
@[simp]
theorem singularPairEquiv_principalPair (p : ℕ) (gamma : Kˣ) :
    A.singularPairEquiv p (principalPair (R := R) (K := K) p gamma) =
      principalPair (R := R) (K := K) p (A.unitEquiv gamma)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.SingularPair.PrincipalIdealPreservingEquiv.singularPairEquiv_unitPair
statement:
@[simp]
theorem singularPairEquiv_unitPair (p : ℕ)
    (u : fractionalUnitSubgroup (R := R) (K := K)) :
    A.singularPairEquiv p (unitPair (R := R) (K := K) p u) =
      unitPair (R := R) (K := K) p (A.fractionalUnitEquiv u)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.SingularPair.PrincipalIdealPreservingEquiv.unitToSingularGroup_equivariant
statement:
theorem unitToSingularGroup_equivariant (p : ℕ)
    (u : fractionalUnitSubgroup (R := R) (K := K)) :
    A.singularGroupEquiv p (unitToSingularGroup (R := R) (K := K) p u) =
      unitToSingularGroup (R := R) (K := K) p (A.fractionalUnitEquiv u)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelProjectionBridge.elementaryQuotient_nontrivial_of_component_le_subgroup_image
statement:
theorem elementaryQuotient_nontrivial_of_component_le_subgroup_image
    [NeZero p] (i : ℕ) (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A))
    (B : AddSubgroup A)
    (hV : ElementaryComponentNontrivial (p := p) i ρ)
    (hcover :
      elementaryComponent (p := p) i ρ ≤
        LinearMap.range (subgroupElementaryQuotientLinearMap (p := p) B)) :
    Nontrivial (ElementaryQuotient B p)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelProjectionBridge.nsmul_elementaryQuotient_eq_zmod_smul
statement:
theorem nsmul_elementaryQuotient_eq_zmod_smul [NeZero p]
    (n : ℕ) (x : ElementaryQuotient A p) :
    n • x = (n : ZMod p) • x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelProjectionBridge.nsmul_ordCompl_mem_primaryComponent
statement:
theorem nsmul_ordCompl_mem_primaryComponent
    [Fact p.Prime] [Finite A] (x : A) :
    (ordCompl[p] (addOrderOf x)) • x ∈ AddCommGroup.primaryComponent A p

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelProjectionBridge.primaryComponent_elementaryQuotientLinearMap_surjective
statement:
theorem primaryComponent_elementaryQuotientLinearMap_surjective
    [Fact p.Prime] [Finite A] [NeZero p] :
    Function.Surjective
      (subgroupElementaryQuotientLinearMap (p := p)
        (AddCommGroup.primaryComponent A p))

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelProjectionBridge.quotientMap_nsmul_eq_zmod_smul
statement:
theorem quotientMap_nsmul_eq_zmod_smul [NeZero p]

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelProjectionBridge.subgroupElementaryQuotientLinearMap_mk
statement:

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelProjectionBridge.subgroupElementaryQuotientMap_mk

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelProjectionBridge.torsionComponentNontrivial_of_finiteLevelSubgroup
statement:
theorem torsionComponentNontrivial_of_finiteLevelSubgroup
    [NeZero p] (i : ℕ) (ρ : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A))
    (B : AddSubgroup A) [Finite B]

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelIdempotent.apply_projection
statement:
theorem apply_projection
    (rho : D →* M ≃ₗ[ZMod m] M) (chi : D →* (ZMod m)ˣ)
    (b : D) (x : M) :
    rho b (projection (m := m) rho chi x) =
      (chi b : ZMod m) • projection (m := m) rho chi x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelIdempotent.coefficient_inv_mul
statement:
theorem coefficient_inv_mul
    (chi : D →* (ZMod m)ˣ) (b a : D) :
    coefficient (m := m) chi (b⁻¹ * a) =
      (chi b : ZMod m) * coefficient (m := m) chi a

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelIdempotent.coefficient_mul_character
statement:
theorem coefficient_mul_character
    (chi : D →* (ZMod m)ˣ) (d : D) :
    coefficient (m := m) chi d * (chi d : ZMod m) =
      (Fintype.card D : ZMod m)⁻¹

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelIdempotent.mem_range_apply
statement:
theorem mem_range_apply
    (rho : D →* M ≃ₗ[ZMod m] M) (chi : D →* (ZMod m)ˣ)
    (b : D) {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range (projection (m := m) rho chi)) :
    rho b x = (chi b : ZMod m) • x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelIdempotent.projection_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projection_apply
    (rho : D →* M ≃ₗ[ZMod m] M) (chi : D →* (ZMod m)ˣ) (x : M) :
    projection (m := m) rho chi x =
      ∑ d : D, coefficient (m := m) chi d • rho d x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelIdempotent.projection_apply_eq_self_of_mem_range
statement:
theorem projection_apply_eq_self_of_mem_range
    (hcard : IsUnit (Fintype.card D : ZMod m))
    (rho : D →* M ≃ₗ[ZMod m] M) (chi : D →* (ZMod m)ˣ)
    {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ LinearMap.range (projection (m := m) rho chi)) :
    projection (m := m) rho chi x = x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelIdempotent.projection_apply_projection
statement:
theorem projection_apply_projection
    (hcard : IsUnit (Fintype.card D : ZMod m))
    (rho : D →* M ≃ₗ[ZMod m] M) (chi : D →* (ZMod m)ˣ) (x : M) :
    projection (m := m) rho chi (projection (m := m) rho chi x) =
      projection (m := m) rho chi x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelAdditiveProjection.addEquivToZModLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem addEquivToZModLinearEquiv_apply (e : A ≃+ A) (x : A) :
    addEquivToZModLinearEquiv (m := m) e x = e x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelAdditiveProjection.apply_eq_character_smul_of_mem_component
statement:
theorem apply_eq_character_smul_of_mem_component
    (rho : D →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)) (chi : D →* (ZMod m)ˣ)
    (d : D) {x : A}
    (hx : x ∈ componentSubgroup (m := m) rho chi) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (rho d) x = (chi d : ZMod m) • x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelAdditiveProjection.linearAction_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem linearAction_apply (rho : D →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)) (d : D) (x : A) :
    linearAction (m := m) rho d x = Multiplicative.toAdd (rho d) x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelAdditiveProjection.mem_componentSubgroup_iff
statement:
theorem mem_componentSubgroup_iff
    (rho : D →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)) (chi : D →* (ZMod m)ˣ) {x : A} :
    x ∈ componentSubgroup (m := m) rho chi ↔
      x ∈ LinearMap.range (projection (m := m) rho chi)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelAdditiveProjection.projection_apply_eq_self_of_mem_component
statement:
theorem projection_apply_eq_self_of_mem_component
    (hcard : IsUnit (Fintype.card D : ZMod m))

    {x : A}
    (hx : x ∈ componentSubgroup (m := m) rho chi) :

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelAdditiveProjection.projection_apply_projection
statement:
theorem projection_apply_projection
    (hcard : IsUnit (Fintype.card D : ZMod m))
    (rho : D →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A)) (chi : D →* (ZMod m)ˣ) (x : A) :
    projection (m := m) rho chi (projection (m := m) rho chi x) =

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelTorsionReduction.mem_torsionComponent_of_mem_finiteLevelComponent
statement:
theorem mem_torsionComponent_of_mem_finiteLevelComponent
    (hcard : IsUnit (Fintype.card (CharacterProjection.Delta p) : ZMod p))
    (hm : p ∣ m) (i : ℕ)
    (rho : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A))
    (chi : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* (ZMod m)ˣ)
    (hchi : ∀ d : CharacterProjection.Delta p,
      ZMod.castHom hm (ZMod p) (chi d : ZMod m) = ((d : ZMod p) ^ i))
    {x : TorsionComponent.PTorsion A p}
    (hx : (x : A) ∈
      FiniteLevelAdditiveProjection.componentSubgroup (m := m) rho chi) :
    x ∈ TorsionComponent.torsionComponent (p := p) i rho

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelTorsionReduction.nsmul_ptorsion_eq_zmod_smul
statement:
theorem nsmul_ptorsion_eq_zmod_smul
    (n : ℕ) (x : TorsionComponent.PTorsion A p) :

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelTorsionReduction.zmod_smul_ptorsion_eq_of_castHom_eq
statement:
theorem zmod_smul_ptorsion_eq_of_castHom_eq
    (hm : p ∣ m) (c : ZMod m) (a : ZMod p)
    (x : TorsionComponent.PTorsion A p)
    (hc : ZMod.castHom hm (ZMod p) c = a) :

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelQuotientComparison.elementaryComponent_le_finiteLevelComponent_image
statement:
theorem elementaryComponent_le_finiteLevelComponent_image
    (hm : p ∣ m) (i : ℕ)
    (rho : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A))
    (chi : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* (ZMod m)ˣ)
    (hcoeff : ∀ d : CharacterProjection.Delta p,
      ZMod.castHom hm (ZMod p)
          (FiniteLevelIdempotent.coefficient (m := m) chi d) =
        CharacterProjection.characterProjectionCoefficient (p := p) i d) :
    elementaryComponent (p := p) i rho ≤
      LinearMap.range

          (p := p)
          (FiniteLevelAdditiveProjection.componentSubgroup (m := m) rho chi))

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelQuotientComparison.nsmul_elementaryQuotient_eq_zmod_smul
statement:
theorem nsmul_elementaryQuotient_eq_zmod_smul
    (n : ℕ) (x : ElementaryQuotient A p) :
    n • x = (n : ZMod p) • x

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelQuotientComparison.quotientMap_finiteLevelProjection
statement:
theorem quotientMap_finiteLevelProjection
    (hm : p ∣ m) (i : ℕ)
    (rho : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* Multiplicative (A ≃+ A))
    (chi : CharacterProjection.Delta p →* (ZMod m)ˣ)
    (hcoeff : ∀ d : CharacterProjection.Delta p,
      ZMod.castHom hm (ZMod p)
          (FiniteLevelIdempotent.coefficient (m := m) chi d) =
        CharacterProjection.characterProjectionCoefficient (p := p) i d)
    (x : A) :
    quotientMap A p
        (FiniteLevelAdditiveProjection.projection (m := m) rho chi x) =
      elementaryProjection (p := p) i rho (quotientMap A p x)

name: BernoulliRegular.Reflection.SingularKummer.FiniteLevelQuotientComparison.quotientMap_zmod_smul_eq_of_castHom_eq
statement:
theorem quotientMap_zmod_smul_eq_of_castHom_eq

theorem torsionComponentNontrivial_of_finiteLevelCharacter_cast

name: BernoulliRegular.stickelbergerElement_def
statement:
@[simp] lemma stickelbergerElement_def :

      (p : ℚ)⁻¹ •
        ∑ a : (ZMod p)ˣ, ((a : ZMod p).val : ℚ) • MonoidAlgebra.single a⁻¹ (1 : ℚ)

name: BernoulliRegular.stickelbergerScaled_apply_inv

      ∑ a : (ZMod p)ˣ, ((a : ZMod p).val : ℤ) • MonoidAlgebra.single a⁻¹ (1 : ℤ)

name: BernoulliRegular.stickelbergerScaled_eq_stickelbergerCoefficientPackage
statement:

statement:
theorem mapRangeRingHom_stickelbergerCorrectedInt (c : (ZMod p)ˣ) :

        (stickelbergerCorrectedInt p c) =
      (((c : ZMod p).val : ℚ) • (1 : MonoidAlgebra ℚ (ZMod p)ˣ) -

name: BernoulliRegular.mapRangeRingHom_stickelbergerScaled

    MonoidAlgebra.mapRingHom (ZMod p)ˣ (Int.castRingHom ℚ) (stickelbergerScaled p) =
      (p : ℚ) • stickelbergerElement p

name: BernoulliRegular.p_smul_stickelbergerCorrectedInt

theorem p_smul_stickelbergerCorrectedInt (c : (ZMod p)ˣ) :

      (((c : ZMod p).val : ℤ) • (1 : MonoidAlgebra ℤ (ZMod p)ˣ) -

name: BernoulliRegular.rat_stickelbergerCorrectedCoeff
statement:
lemma rat_stickelbergerCorrectedCoeff (c b : (ZMod p)ˣ) :
    ((c : ZMod p).val * (b : ZMod p).val : ℚ) - (((c * b : (ZMod p)ˣ) : ZMod p).val : ℚ)
      = (p : ℚ) * (stickelbergerCorrectedCoeff p c b : ℚ)

name: BernoulliRegular.single_mul_stickelbergerScaled

lemma single_mul_stickelbergerScaled (c : (ZMod p)ˣ) :

      ∑ b : (ZMod p)ˣ, (((b * c : (ZMod p)ˣ) : ZMod p).val : ℤ) •
        MonoidAlgebra.single b⁻¹ (1 : ℤ)

statement:
lemma smul_one_mul_stickelbergerScaled (c : (ZMod p)ˣ) :
    (((c : ZMod p).val : ℤ) • (1 : MonoidAlgebra ℤ (ZMod p)ˣ)) * stickelbergerScaled p =
      ∑ a : (ZMod p)ˣ, (((c : ZMod p).val : ℤ) * ((a : ZMod p).val : ℤ)) •

name: BernoulliRegular.stickelbergerCorrectedCoeff_mul_p

    {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E] [Module Λ E]
