theorem diagScale_apply (c : ι → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, c i ≠ 0) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (i : ι) :
    diagScale c hc x i = c i * x i

name: DedekindResidue.diagScale_congr
statement:
theorem diagScale_congr {c c' : ι → ℝ} (h : c = c') (hc : ∀ i, c i ≠ 0) :
    diagScale c hc = diagScale c' (h ▸ hc)

name: DedekindResidue.diagScale_symm
statement:
theorem diagScale_symm (c : ι → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, c i ≠ 0) :
    (diagScale c hc).symm = diagScale (fun i => (c i)⁻¹) (fun i => inv_ne_zero (hc i))

name: DedekindResidue.finite_norm_le_zlattice
statement:
theorem finite_norm_le_zlattice (L : Submodule ℤ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))
    [DiscreteTopology L] (R : ℝ) :
    {v : L | ‖(v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)‖ ≤ R}.Finite

name: DedekindResidue.fourier_gaussianCM
statement:
theorem fourier_gaussianCM {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    𝓕 (⇑(gaussianCM (ι := ι) t)) w
      = ((t ^ (-(Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * gaussianCM t⁻¹ w

name: DedekindResidue.fourier_weightedGaussianCM
statement:
theorem fourier_weightedGaussianCM {c : ι → ℝ} (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    𝓕 (⇑(weightedGaussianCM (ι := ι) c)) w
      = (Real.sqrt (∏ i, c i))⁻¹ • weightedGaussianCM (fun i => (c i)⁻¹) w

name: DedekindResidue.norm_diagScale_sqrt_sq
statement:
theorem norm_diagScale_sqrt_sq (c : ι → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ‖diagScale (fun i => Real.sqrt (c i)) (fun i => Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (hc i)) x‖ ^ 2
      = ∑ i, c i * x i ^ 2

name: DedekindResidue.norm_gaussianCM_apply
statement:
theorem norm_gaussianCM_apply (t : ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ‖gaussianCM t x‖ = Real.exp (-(π * t) * ‖x‖ ^ 2)

name: DedekindResidue.norm_sq_eq_sum
statement: theorem norm_sq_eq_sum (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) : ‖y‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, y i ^ 2

name: DedekindResidue.norm_weightedGaussianCM_apply
statement:
theorem norm_weightedGaussianCM_apply (c : ι → ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ‖weightedGaussianCM c y‖ = Real.exp (-π * ∑ i, c i * y i ^ 2)

name: DedekindResidue.norm_weightedGaussianCM_le
statement:
theorem norm_weightedGaussianCM_le (c : ι → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (hca : ∀ i, a ≤ c i)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ‖weightedGaussianCM c y‖ ≤ ‖gaussianCM a y‖

name: DedekindResidue.ofReal_thetaLattice
statement:
theorem ofReal_thetaLattice (M : Submodule ℤ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))
    [DiscreteTopology M] [IsZLattice ℝ M] {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    ((thetaLattice M s : ℝ) : ℂ) = ∑' v : M, gaussianCM (ι := ι) s (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)

name: DedekindResidue.ofReal_weightedTheta
statement:
theorem ofReal_weightedTheta (M : Submodule ℤ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))
    [DiscreteTopology M] [IsZLattice ℝ M] {d : ι → ℝ} {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hdb : ∀ i, b ≤ d i) :
    ((∑' v : M, Real.exp (-π * ∑ i, d i * ((v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) i) ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      = ∑' v : M, weightedGaussianCM (ι := ι) d (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)

name: DedekindResidue.summable_fourier_gaussianCM
statement:
theorem summable_fourier_gaussianCM (L : Submodule ℤ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    Summable fun w : dualZLattice L =>
      𝓕 (⇑(gaussianCM (ι := ι) t)) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)

name: DedekindResidue.summable_fourier_weightedGaussianCM
statement:
theorem summable_fourier_weightedGaussianCM (L : Submodule ℤ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] {c : ι → ℝ} (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 < B) (hcB : ∀ i, c i ≤ B) :
    Summable fun w : dualZLattice L =>
      𝓕 (⇑(weightedGaussianCM (ι := ι) c)) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)

name: DedekindResidue.summable_norm_restrict_gaussianCM
statement:
theorem summable_norm_restrict_gaussianCM (L : Submodule ℤ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t)
    (K : Compacts (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) :
    Summable fun v : L =>
      ‖((gaussianCM t).comp (ContinuousMap.addRight (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))).restrict
        (K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))‖

name: DedekindResidue.summable_norm_restrict_weightedGaussianCM
statement:
theorem summable_norm_restrict_weightedGaussianCM (L : Submodule ℤ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] {c : ι → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hca : ∀ i, a ≤ c i) (K : Compacts (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)) :
    Summable fun v : L =>
      ‖((weightedGaussianCM c).comp (ContinuousMap.addRight (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))).restrict
        (K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))‖

name: DedekindResidue.summable_thetaLattice
statement:
theorem summable_thetaLattice (L : Submodule ℤ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    Summable (fun v : L => Real.exp (-(π * t) * ‖(v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)‖ ^ 2))

name: DedekindResidue.thetaLattice_transform
statement:
theorem thetaLattice_transform (L : Submodule ℤ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    thetaLattice L t = (ZLattice.covolume L volume)⁻¹ * t ^ (-(Fintype.card ι : ℝ) / 2)
      * thetaLattice (dualZLattice L) t⁻¹

name: DedekindResidue.weightedGaussianCM_eq_comp
statement:
theorem weightedGaussianCM_eq_comp (c : ι → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    weightedGaussianCM c x
      = gaussianCM 1 ((diagScale (fun i => Real.sqrt (c i))
          (fun i => Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (hc i))) x)

name: DedekindResidue.weightedThetaLattice_transform
statement:
theorem weightedThetaLattice_transform (L : Submodule ℤ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] {c : ι → ℝ} (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i) :
    ∑' v : L, Real.exp (-π * ∑ i, c i * ((v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) i) ^ 2)
      = (ZLattice.covolume L volume)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (∏ i, c i))⁻¹
        * ∑' w : dualZLattice L,
            Real.exp (-π * ∑ i, (c i)⁻¹ * ((w : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) i) ^ 2)

name: DedekindResidue.absNorm_dualIdealUnit
statement:
theorem absNorm_dualIdealUnit (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
    FractionalIdeal.absNorm ((dualIdealUnit K I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
        FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)
      = (FractionalIdeal.absNorm (I : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K))⁻¹
          * (((discr K).natAbs : ℚ))⁻¹

name: DedekindResidue.comap_le_dualZLattice
statement:
theorem comap_le_dualZLattice (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
    ZLattice.comap ℝ (idealZLattice K (dualIdealUnit K I))
        ((diagScale (dualityWeights K)
          (dualityWeights_ne_zero K)).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toLinearMap)
      ≤ dualZLattice (idealZLattice K I)

name: DedekindResidue.covolume_idealZLattice
statement:
theorem covolume_idealZLattice (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
    ZLattice.covolume (idealZLattice K I) volume
      = (FractionalIdeal.absNorm (I : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K))
          * (2⁻¹) ^ nrComplexPlaces K * Real.sqrt |discr K|

name: DedekindResidue.dualZLattice_idealZLattice
statement:
theorem dualZLattice_idealZLattice (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
    dualZLattice (idealZLattice K I)
      = ZLattice.comap ℝ (idealZLattice K (dualIdealUnit K I))
          ((diagScale (dualityWeights K)
            (dualityWeights_ne_zero K)).symm.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toLinearMap)

name: DedekindResidue.dualityWeights_ne_zero
statement: theorem dualityWeights_ne_zero : ∀ i, dualityWeights K i ≠ 0

name: DedekindResidue.embeddingCoords_apply
statement:
theorem embeddingCoords_apply (x : K) (i : index K) :
    embeddingCoords K x i = (stdBasis K).repr (mixedEmbedding K x) i

name: DedekindResidue.embeddingCoords_isComplex_fst
statement:
theorem embeddingCoords_isComplex_fst (x : K) (w : {w : InfinitePlace K // IsComplex w}) :
    embeddingCoords K x (Sum.inr ⟨w, 0⟩) = ((w : InfinitePlace K).embedding x).re

name: DedekindResidue.embeddingCoords_isComplex_snd
statement:
theorem embeddingCoords_isComplex_snd (x : K) (w : {w : InfinitePlace K // IsComplex w}) :
    embeddingCoords K x (Sum.inr ⟨w, 1⟩) = ((w : InfinitePlace K).embedding x).im

name: DedekindResidue.embeddingCoords_isReal
statement:
theorem embeddingCoords_isReal (x : K) (w : {w : InfinitePlace K // IsReal w}) :
    embeddingCoords K x (Sum.inl w) = embedding_of_isReal w.2 x

name: DedekindResidue.fracAbsNorm_inv
statement:
theorem fracAbsNorm_inv (J : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K) (hJ : J ≠ 0) :
    FractionalIdeal.absNorm J⁻¹ = (FractionalIdeal.absNorm J)⁻¹

name: DedekindResidue.idealTheta_transform
statement:
theorem idealTheta_transform (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    idealTheta K I t
      = ((FractionalIdeal.absNorm (I : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K))
            * (2⁻¹) ^ nrComplexPlaces K * Real.sqrt |discr K|)⁻¹
          * t ^ (-(Fintype.card (index K) : ℝ) / 2)
          * thetaLattice (dualZLattice (idealZLattice K I)) t⁻¹

name: DedekindResidue.inner_diagScale_embeddingCoords
statement:
theorem inner_diagScale_embeddingCoords (a b : K) :
    ⟪(diagScale (dualityWeights K) (dualityWeights_ne_zero K)) (embeddingCoords K b),
      embeddingCoords K a⟫ = ((Algebra.trace ℚ K (b * a) : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: DedekindResidue.mem_idealZLattice
statement:
theorem mem_idealZLattice (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (index K)) :
    x ∈ idealZLattice K I
      ↔ ∃ a ∈ (I : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K), embeddingCoords K a = x

name: DedekindResidue.prod_dualityWeights
statement:
theorem prod_dualityWeights :
    (∏ i : index K, dualityWeights K i) = (-4 : ℝ) ^ nrComplexPlaces K

name: DedekindResidue.dualPlaceWeights_heckeWeights
statement:
theorem dualPlaceWeights_heckeWeights {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (u : logSpace K)
    (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    dualPlaceWeights K (heckeWeights K t u) w
      = (if IsReal w then 1 else 4) * heckeWeights K t⁻¹ (-u) w

name: DedekindResidue.dualPlaceWeights_heckeWeights_eq
statement:
theorem dualPlaceWeights_heckeWeights_eq {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (u : logSpace K) :
    dualPlaceWeights K (heckeWeights K t u)
      = heckeWeights K ((4 : ℝ) ^ (2 * nrComplexPlaces K) * t⁻¹) (-u + dualShift K)

name: DedekindResidue.finrank_pos_real
statement: theorem finrank_pos_real : (0 : ℝ) < (Module.finrank ℚ K : ℝ)

name: DedekindResidue.fullLog_add
statement:
theorem fullLog_add (u v : logSpace K) :
    fullLog K (u + v) = fullLog K u + fullLog K v

name: DedekindResidue.fullLog_dualShift
statement:
theorem fullLog_dualShift (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    fullLog K (dualShift K) w
      = (mult w : ℝ) / 2 * ((if IsReal w then 0 else Real.log 4)
          - 2 * nrComplexPlaces K * Real.log 4 / Module.finrank ℚ K)

name: DedekindResidue.fullLog_logEmbedding
statement:
theorem fullLog_logEmbedding (ε : (𝓞 K)ˣ) (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    fullLog K (logEmbedding K (Additive.ofMul ε)) w
      = mult w * Real.log (w (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K (ε : 𝓞 K)))

name: DedekindResidue.fullLog_neg
statement: theorem fullLog_neg (u : logSpace K) : fullLog K (-u) = -fullLog K u

name: DedekindResidue.fullLog_restrict
statement:
theorem fullLog_restrict (y : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (hy : ∑ w, y w = 0) :
    fullLog K (fun w : {w : InfinitePlace K // w ≠ (w₀ : InfinitePlace K)} => y w) = y

name: DedekindResidue.fullLog_xShift
statement:
theorem fullLog_xShift {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    fullLog K (xShift K x) w
      = (mult w : ℝ) * Real.log (w x)
        - (mult w : ℝ) * Real.log ((|Algebra.norm ℚ x| : ℚ) : ℝ) / Module.finrank ℚ K

name: DedekindResidue.heckeG_inversion
statement:
theorem heckeG_inversion (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    heckeG K I t
      = (ZLattice.covolume (idealZLattice K I) volume)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt t)⁻¹
        * heckeG K (dualIdealUnit K I) ((4 : ℝ) ^ (2 * nrComplexPlaces K) * t⁻¹)

name: DedekindResidue.heckeG_principal_mul
statement:
theorem heckeG_principal_mul (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) (x : Kˣ) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    heckeG K (toPrincipalIdeal (𝓞 K) K x * I) t
      = heckeG K I (((|Algebra.norm ℚ (x : K)| : ℚ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * t)

name: DedekindResidue.heckeTheta_heckeWeights_periodic
statement:
theorem heckeTheta_heckeWeights_periodic (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)
    (t : ℝ) (u : logSpace K) (ε : (𝓞 K)ˣ) :
    heckeTheta K I (heckeWeights K t (u + logEmbedding K (Additive.ofMul ε)))
      = heckeTheta K I (heckeWeights K t u)

name: DedekindResidue.heckeTheta_inversion
statement:
theorem heckeTheta_inversion (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)
    (c : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (hc : ∀ w, 0 < c w) :
    heckeTheta K I c
      = (ZLattice.covolume (idealZLattice K I) volume)⁻¹
        * (Real.sqrt (∏ i, placeWeights K c i))⁻¹
        * heckeTheta K (dualIdealUnit K I) (dualPlaceWeights K c)

name: DedekindResidue.heckeTheta_principal_mul
statement:
theorem heckeTheta_principal_mul (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) (x : Kˣ)
    (c : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) :
    heckeTheta K (toPrincipalIdeal (𝓞 K) K x * I) c
      = heckeTheta K I (fun w => (w (x : K)) ^ 2 * c w)

name: DedekindResidue.heckeTheta_unit_mul
statement:
theorem heckeTheta_unit_mul (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) (ε : (𝓞 K)ˣ)
    (c : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) :
    heckeTheta K I (fun w => (w (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K (ε : 𝓞 K))) ^ 2 * c w)
      = heckeTheta K I c

name: DedekindResidue.heckeWeights_add_logEmbedding
statement:
theorem heckeWeights_add_logEmbedding (t : ℝ) (u : logSpace K) (ε : (𝓞 K)ˣ) :
    heckeWeights K t (u + logEmbedding K (Additive.ofMul ε))
      = fun w => (w (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K (ε : 𝓞 K))) ^ 2 * heckeWeights K t u w

name: DedekindResidue.heckeWeights_add_right
statement:
theorem heckeWeights_add_right (t : ℝ) (u v : logSpace K) (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    heckeWeights K t (u + v) w
      = Real.exp (2 * fullLog K v w / mult w) * heckeWeights K t u w

name: DedekindResidue.heckeWeights_mul_left
statement:
theorem heckeWeights_mul_left {a t : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (u : logSpace K)
    (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    heckeWeights K (a * t) u w
      = a ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (Module.finrank ℚ K)) * heckeWeights K t u w

name: DedekindResidue.heckeWeights_pos
statement:
theorem heckeWeights_pos {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (u : logSpace K) (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    0 < heckeWeights K t u w

name: DedekindResidue.ite_mul_heckeWeights
statement:
theorem ite_mul_heckeWeights {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (u : logSpace K) (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    (if IsReal w then (1 : ℝ) else 4) * heckeWeights K t u w
      = heckeWeights K ((4 : ℝ) ^ (2 * nrComplexPlaces K) * t) (u + dualShift K) w

name: DedekindResidue.mem_idealZLattice_principal_mul
statement:
theorem mem_idealZLattice_principal_mul (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) (x : Kˣ)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (index K)) :
    v ∈ idealZLattice K (toPrincipalIdeal (𝓞 K) K x * I)
      ↔ ∃ a ∈ (I : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K), embeddingCoords K ((x : K) * a) = v

name: DedekindResidue.mulCoords_embeddingCoords
statement:
theorem mulCoords_embeddingCoords (x a : K) :
    mulCoords K x (embeddingCoords K a) = embeddingCoords K (x * a)

name: DedekindResidue.mult_ne_zero_real
statement: theorem mult_ne_zero_real (w : InfinitePlace K) : (mult w : ℝ) ≠ 0

name: DedekindResidue.placeWeights_dualPlaceWeights
statement:
theorem placeWeights_dualPlaceWeights (c : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (i : index K) :
    placeWeights K (dualPlaceWeights K c) i
      = (placeWeights K c i)⁻¹ * (dualityWeights K i) ^ 2

name: DedekindResidue.prod_heckeWeights_pow_mult
statement:
theorem prod_heckeWeights_pow_mult {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (u : logSpace K) :
    ∏ w : InfinitePlace K, (heckeWeights K t u w) ^ mult w = t

name: DedekindResidue.prod_placeWeights
statement:
theorem prod_placeWeights (c : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) :
    (∏ i : index K, placeWeights K c i) = ∏ w : InfinitePlace K, c w ^ mult w

name: DedekindResidue.prod_placeWeights_heckeWeights
statement:
theorem prod_placeWeights_heckeWeights {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (u : logSpace K) :
    (∏ i : index K, placeWeights K (heckeWeights K t u) i) = t

name: DedekindResidue.setIntegral_fundamentalDomain_comp_add
statement:
theorem setIntegral_fundamentalDomain_comp_add {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (b : Module.Basis κ ℝ (ι → ℝ)) (s : ι → ℝ) (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ l : Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range ⇑b), ∀ x, f (↑l + x) = f x) :
    ∫ u in ZSpan.fundamentalDomain b, f (u + s)
      = ∫ u in ZSpan.fundamentalDomain b, f u

name: DedekindResidue.setIntegral_fundamentalDomain_comp_neg_add
statement:
theorem setIntegral_fundamentalDomain_comp_neg_add {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (b : Module.Basis κ ℝ (ι → ℝ)) (s : ι → ℝ) (f : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ l : Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range ⇑b), ∀ x, f (↑l + x) = f x) :
    ∫ u in ZSpan.fundamentalDomain b, f (-u + s)
      = ∫ u in ZSpan.fundamentalDomain b, f u

name: DedekindResidue.sq_mul_heckeWeights
statement:
theorem sq_mul_heckeWeights {x : K} (hx : x ≠ 0) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (u : logSpace K)
    (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    (w x) ^ 2 * heckeWeights K t u w
      = heckeWeights K (((|Algebra.norm ℚ x| : ℚ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * t) (u + xShift K x) w

name: DedekindResidue.sum_fullLog
statement: theorem sum_fullLog (u : logSpace K) : ∑ w : InfinitePlace K, fullLog K u w = 0

name: DedekindResidue.sum_mult_mul_log
statement:
theorem sum_mult_mul_log (x : K) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∑ w : InfinitePlace K, (mult w : ℝ) * Real.log (w x)
      = Real.log ((|Algebra.norm ℚ x| : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: DedekindResidue.sum_placeWeights_embeddingCoords_sq
statement:
theorem sum_placeWeights_embeddingCoords_sq (c : InfinitePlace K → ℝ) (x : K) :
    (∑ i : index K, placeWeights K c i * embeddingCoords K x i ^ 2)
      = ∑ w : InfinitePlace K, c w * (w x) ^ 2

name: DedekindResidue.absNorm_unit_ne_zero
statement:
theorem absNorm_unit_ne_zero (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
    FractionalIdeal.absNorm (I : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K) ≠ 0

name: DedekindResidue.classGroup_mk_eq_mk_iff
statement:
theorem classGroup_mk_eq_mk_iff {I J : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ} :
    ClassGroup.mk K I = ClassGroup.mk K J
      ↔ ∃ x : Kˣ, toPrincipalIdeal (𝓞 K) K x * I = J

name: DedekindResidue.dualClass_bijective
statement: theorem dualClass_bijective : Function.Bijective (dualClass K)

name: DedekindResidue.dualIdealUnit_eq_mul_inv
statement:
theorem dualIdealUnit_eq_mul_inv (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
    dualIdealUnit K I = dualIdealUnit K 1 * I⁻¹

name: DedekindResidue.heckeBeta_pos
statement: theorem heckeBeta_pos : 0 < heckeBeta K

name: DedekindResidue.heckeF_inversion
statement:
theorem heckeF_inversion {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    heckeF K (1 / x) = Real.sqrt x * heckeF K x

name: DedekindResidue.heckeGClass_eq
statement:
theorem heckeGClass_eq {C : ClassGroup (𝓞 K)} (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)
    (h : ClassGroup.mk K I = C) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    heckeGClass K C x = heckeG K I ((idealNormR K I)⁻¹ ^ 2 * heckeBeta K * x)

name: DedekindResidue.heckeGClass_inversion
statement:
theorem heckeGClass_inversion (C : ClassGroup (𝓞 K)) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    heckeGClass K C (1 / x) = Real.sqrt x * heckeGClass K (dualClass K C) x

name: DedekindResidue.heckeG_normalized_eq_of_mk_eq
statement:
theorem heckeG_normalized_eq_of_mk_eq {I J : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ}
    (h : ClassGroup.mk K I = ClassGroup.mk K J) {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    heckeG K I ((idealNormR K I)⁻¹ ^ 2 * heckeBeta K * x)
      = heckeG K J ((idealNormR K J)⁻¹ ^ 2 * heckeBeta K * x)

name: DedekindResidue.idealNormR_dualIdealUnit
statement:
theorem idealNormR_dualIdealUnit (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
    idealNormR K (dualIdealUnit K I)
      = (idealNormR K I)⁻¹ * (((discr K).natAbs : ℝ))⁻¹

name: DedekindResidue.idealNormR_pos
statement: theorem idealNormR_pos (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) : 0 < idealNormR K I

name: DedekindResidue.idealNormR_principal_mul
statement:
theorem idealNormR_principal_mul (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) (y : Kˣ) :
    idealNormR K (toPrincipalIdeal (𝓞 K) K y * I)
      = ((|Algebra.norm ℚ (y : K)| : ℚ) : ℝ) * idealNormR K I

name: DedekindResidue.mk_classRep
statement: theorem mk_classRep (C : ClassGroup (𝓞 K)) : ClassGroup.mk K (classRep K C) = C

name: DedekindResidue.mk_dualIdealUnit
statement:
theorem mk_dualIdealUnit (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
    ClassGroup.mk K (dualIdealUnit K I) = dualClass K (ClassGroup.mk K I)

name: DedekindResidue.natAbs_discr_pos
statement: theorem natAbs_discr_pos : (0 : ℝ) < ((discr K).natAbs : ℝ)

name: DedekindResidue.val_unit_inv
statement:
theorem val_unit_inv (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
    ((I⁻¹ : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)
      = (I : FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)⁻¹

name: DedekindResidue.abs_fullLog_le
statement:
theorem abs_fullLog_le {u : logSpace K} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hu : ∀ i, |u i| ≤ R) (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    |fullLog K u w| ≤ (Fintype.card (InfinitePlace K)) * R

name: DedekindResidue.continuousAt_heckeTheta_heckeWeights
statement:
theorem continuousAt_heckeTheta_heckeWeights (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)
    {p : ℝ × logSpace K} (hp : 0 < p.1) :
    ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × logSpace K =>
      heckeTheta K I (heckeWeights K q.1 q.2)) p

name: DedekindResidue.continuousOn_heckeG
statement:
theorem continuousOn_heckeG (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
    ContinuousOn (heckeG K I) (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))

name: DedekindResidue.continuousOn_heckeWeights_apply
statement:
lemma continuousOn_heckeWeights_apply (a R : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    ContinuousOn (fun q : ℝ × logSpace K => heckeWeights K q.1 q.2 w)
      (Set.Ioi a ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : logSpace K) R)

name: DedekindResidue.continuous_fullLog
statement:
lemma continuous_fullLog (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    Continuous (fun u : logSpace K => fullLog K u w)

name: DedekindResidue.exists_box_coord_bound
statement:
theorem exists_box_coord_bound :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R ∧ ∀ u ∈ ZSpan.fundamentalDomain
      ((Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ (unitLattice K)).ofZLatticeBasis ℝ),
      ∀ i, |u i| ≤ R

name: DedekindResidue.exists_heckeG_dev_bound
statement:
theorem exists_heckeG_dev_bound (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
    ∃ C c' : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < c' ∧ ∀ {t : ℝ}, 1 ≤ t →
      |heckeG K I t - (torsionOrder K : ℝ)⁻¹ * unitBoxVol K|
        ≤ C * Real.exp (-c' * t ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (Module.finrank ℚ K)))

name: DedekindResidue.exists_heckeTheta_dev_bound
statement:
theorem exists_heckeTheta_dev_bound (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) :
    ∃ C c' : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < c' ∧
      ∀ {t : ℝ}, 1 ≤ t → ∀ u ∈ ZSpan.fundamentalDomain
        ((Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ (unitLattice K)).ofZLatticeBasis ℝ),
        0 ≤ heckeTheta K I (heckeWeights K t u) - 1
          ∧ heckeTheta K I (heckeWeights K t u) - 1
              ≤ C * Real.exp (-c' * t ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (Module.finrank ℚ K)))

name: DedekindResidue.exists_pos_norm_le_of_discrete
statement:
theorem exists_pos_norm_le_of_discrete (L : Submodule ℤ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))
    [DiscreteTopology L] :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ v : L, v ≠ 0 → δ ≤ ‖(v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)‖

name: DedekindResidue.exp_weighted_le_exp_iso
statement:
theorem exp_weighted_le_exp_iso {c : ι → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (hca : ∀ i, a ≤ c i)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    Real.exp (-π * ∑ i, c i * (x i) ^ 2) ≤ Real.exp (-π * ∑ i, a * (x i) ^ 2)

name: DedekindResidue.heckeTheta_eq_one_add
statement:
theorem heckeTheta_eq_one_add (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ)
    {c : InfinitePlace K → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hca : ∀ w, a ≤ c w) :
    heckeTheta K I c
      = 1 + ∑' v : idealZLattice K I, (if v = 0 then 0
          else Real.exp (-π * ∑ i : index K,
            placeWeights K c i * ((v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (index K)) i) ^ 2))

name: DedekindResidue.heckeTheta_le_iso
statement:
theorem heckeTheta_le_iso (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) {c : InfinitePlace K → ℝ}
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hca : ∀ w, a ≤ c w) :
    heckeTheta K I c ≤ ∑' v : idealZLattice K I,
      Real.exp (-π * ∑ i : index K, a * ((v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (index K)) i) ^ 2)

name: DedekindResidue.le_heckeWeights_of_bounded
statement:
theorem le_heckeWeights_of_bounded {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) {u : logSpace K}
    (hu : ∀ i, |u i| ≤ R) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    Real.exp (-(2 * (Fintype.card (InfinitePlace K)) * R))
        * t ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (Module.finrank ℚ K))
      ≤ heckeWeights K t u w

name: DedekindResidue.le_placeWeights_heckeWeights_on_box
statement:
lemma le_placeWeights_heckeWeights_on_box (a m R a' : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (ha'_def : a' = m * a ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (Module.finrank ℚ K)))
    (hm_def : m = Real.exp (-(2 * (Fintype.card (InfinitePlace K)) * R))) :
    ∀ q : ℝ × logSpace K, q ∈ Set.Ioi a ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : logSpace K) R →
      ∀ i, a' ≤ placeWeights K (heckeWeights K q.1 q.2) i

name: DedekindResidue.summable_real_weightedGaussian
statement:
theorem summable_real_weightedGaussian (L : Submodule ℤ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] {c : ι → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hca : ∀ i, a ≤ c i) :
    Summable fun v : L =>
      Real.exp (-π * ∑ i, c i * ((v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) i) ^ 2)

name: DedekindResidue.tsum_ite_gaussian_tail
statement:
theorem tsum_ite_gaussian_tail (L : Submodule ℤ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι))
    [DiscreteTopology L] [IsZLattice ℝ L] {a a₀ δ : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 < a₀) (haa : a₀ ≤ a)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδL : ∀ v : L, v ≠ 0 → δ ≤ ‖(v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)‖)
    {c : ι → ℝ} (hca : ∀ i, a ≤ c i) :
    (∑' v : L, if v = 0 then 0
        else Real.exp (-π * ∑ i, c i * ((v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) i) ^ 2))
      ≤ Real.exp (-π * (a - a₀) * δ ^ 2)
        * ∑' v : L, Real.exp (-π * ∑ i, a₀ * ((v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) i) ^ 2)

name: DedekindResidue.unitBoxVol_pos
statement: theorem unitBoxVol_pos : 0 < unitBoxVol K

name: DedekindResidue.continuousOn_heckeF
statement: theorem continuousOn_heckeF : ContinuousOn (heckeF K) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))

name: DedekindResidue.continuousOn_heckeGClass
statement:
theorem continuousOn_heckeGClass (C : ClassGroup (𝓞 K)) :
    ContinuousOn (heckeGClass K C) (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))

name: DedekindResidue.exists_heckeF_dev_bound
statement:
theorem exists_heckeF_dev_bound :
    ∃ Cb c' x₀ : ℝ, 0 < Cb ∧ 0 < c' ∧ 1 ≤ x₀ ∧ ∀ {x : ℝ}, x₀ ≤ x →
      |heckeF K x - heckeFConst K|
        ≤ Cb * Real.exp (-c' * x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (Module.finrank ℚ K)))

name: DedekindResidue.exists_heckeGClass_dev_bound
statement:
theorem exists_heckeGClass_dev_bound (C : ClassGroup (𝓞 K)) :
    ∃ Cb c' x₀ : ℝ, 0 < Cb ∧ 0 < c' ∧ 1 ≤ x₀ ∧ ∀ {x : ℝ}, x₀ ≤ x →
      |heckeGClass K C x - (torsionOrder K : ℝ)⁻¹ * unitBoxVol K|
        ≤ Cb * Real.exp (-c' * x ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (Module.finrank ℚ K)))

name: DedekindResidue.heckeF_sub_const_isBigO
statement:
theorem heckeF_sub_const_isBigO (r : ℝ) :
    (fun x : ℝ => heckeF K x - heckeFConst K) =O[atTop] fun x : ℝ => x ^ r

name: DedekindResidue.isBigO_exp_neg_rpow
statement:
theorem isBigO_exp_neg_rpow {c p : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hp : 0 < p) (r : ℝ) :
    (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-c * x ^ p)) =O[atTop] fun x : ℝ => x ^ r

name: DedekindResidue.abs_norm_conePreimage
statement:
theorem abs_norm_conePreimage (J : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) (a : idealSet K J) :
    ((|Algebra.norm ℚ (conePreimage K J a)| : ℚ) : ℝ)
      = (intNorm (idealSetMap K J a) : ℝ)

name: DedekindResidue.conePreimage_ne_zero
statement:
theorem conePreimage_ne_zero (J : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) (a : idealSet K J) :
    conePreimage K J a ≠ 0

name: DedekindResidue.continuous_gaussTerm
statement:
theorem continuous_gaussTerm (t : ℝ) (c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (index K)) :
    Continuous (fun u : logSpace K => gaussTerm K t u c)

name: DedekindResidue.continuous_heckeTheta_heckeWeights
DedekindResidue.count_LSeriesSummable
statement:
theorem count_LSeriesSummable {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) :
    LSeriesSummable (fun n =>
      ((Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℝ) : ℂ)) (s : ℂ)

name: DedekindResidue.dedekindZeta_real_eq
statement:
theorem dedekindZeta_real_eq {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) :
    dedekindZeta K (s : ℂ)
      = ((∑' b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰,
          ((Ideal.absNorm ((b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : ℝ)) ^ (-s) : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: DedekindResidue.ennreal_ofReal_integral_heckeF_dev_eq
statement:
theorem ennreal_ofReal_integral_heckeF_dev_eq {σ : ℝ} (hσ0 : 0 < σ) (h2σ : 1 < 2 * σ)
    (hri : IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (σ - 1) * (heckeF K t - heckeFConst K))
      (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)) volume)
    (hnnae : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ))]
      (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (σ - 1) * (heckeF K t - heckeFConst K))) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (∫ t in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),
        t ^ (σ - 1) * (heckeF K t - heckeFConst K))
      = ENNReal.ofReal ((heckeBeta K) ^ (-σ)
        * ((((heckeJacobian K : ℝ≥0)) : ℝ)
          * ∏ w : InfinitePlace K,
            π ^ (-((mult w : ℝ) * σ)) * Real.Gamma ((mult w : ℝ) * σ))
        * ∑' b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰,
            ((Ideal.absNorm ((b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : ℝ)) ^ (-(2 * σ)))

name: DedekindResidue.euclidMixedEquiv_symm_mixedEmbedding
statement:
theorem euclidMixedEquiv_symm_mixedEmbedding (x : K) :
    (euclidMixedEquiv K).symm (mixedEmbedding K x) = embeddingCoords K x

name: DedekindResidue.gaussTerm_exp_eq
statement:
theorem gaussTerm_exp_eq (τ : ℝ) (u : logSpace K) :
    gaussTerm K (Real.exp τ) u (embeddingCoords K 1)
      = Real.exp (-π * ∑ w : InfinitePlace K, Real.exp ((heckeLogCLE K (τ, u)) w))

name: DedekindResidue.gaussTerm_pos
statement:
theorem gaussTerm_pos (t : ℝ) (u : logSpace K) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (index K)) :
    0 < gaussTerm K t u x

name: DedekindResidue.gaussTerm_unit_smul
statement:
theorem gaussTerm_unit_smul (t : ℝ) (u : logSpace K) (ε : (𝓞 K)ˣ) (y : K) :
    gaussTerm K t u ((euclidMixedEquiv K).symm (ε • mixedEmbedding K y))
      = gaussTerm K t (u + logEmbedding K (Additive.ofMul ε)) (embeddingCoords K y)

name: DedekindResidue.heckeClosedLambdaForm_nonneg
statement:
theorem heckeClosedLambdaForm_nonneg {σ : ℝ} (hσ0 : 0 < σ) :
    (0:ℝ) ≤ (heckeBeta K) ^ (-σ)
      * ((((heckeJacobian K : ℝ≥0)) : ℝ)
        * ∏ w : InfinitePlace K,
          π ^ (-((mult w : ℝ) * σ)) * Real.Gamma ((mult w : ℝ) * σ))
      * ∑' b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰,
          ((Ideal.absNorm ((b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : ℝ)) ^ (-(2 * σ))

name: DedekindResidue.heckeF_dev_nonneg
statement:
theorem heckeF_dev_nonneg {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    0 ≤ heckeF K t - heckeFConst K

name: DedekindResidue.heckeGClass_dev_nonneg
statement:
theorem heckeGClass_dev_nonneg (C : ClassGroup (𝓞 K)) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    0 ≤ heckeGClass K C t - (torsionOrder K : ℝ)⁻¹ * unitBoxVol K

name: DedekindResidue.heckeG_dev_nonneg
statement:
theorem heckeG_dev_nonneg (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    0 ≤ heckeG K I t - (torsionOrder K : ℝ)⁻¹ * unitBoxVol K

name: DedekindResidue.heckeG_sub_const_eq
statement:
theorem heckeG_sub_const_eq (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    heckeG K I t - (torsionOrder K : ℝ)⁻¹ * unitBoxVol K
      = (torsionOrder K : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∫ u in ZSpan.fundamentalDomain
          ((Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ (unitLattice K)).ofZLatticeBasis ℝ),
          (heckeTheta K I (heckeWeights K t u) - 1)

name: DedekindResidue.heckeJacobian_pos
statement: theorem heckeJacobian_pos : 0 < heckeJacobian K

name: DedekindResidue.heckeLogMap_bijective
statement: theorem heckeLogMap_bijective : Function.Bijective (heckeLogMap K)

name: DedekindResidue.heckeLogMap_injective
statement: theorem heckeLogMap_injective : Function.Injective (heckeLogMap K)

name: DedekindResidue.heckeWeights_exp
statement:
theorem heckeWeights_exp (τ : ℝ) (u : logSpace K) (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    heckeWeights K (Real.exp τ) u w = Real.exp ((heckeLogCLE K (τ, u)) w)

name: DedekindResidue.integrable_exp_mul_sub_pi_exp
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_mul_sub_pi_exp {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Integrable (fun l : ℝ => Real.exp (a * l - π * Real.exp l))

name: DedekindResidue.integral_exp_mul_sub_pi_exp
statement:
theorem integral_exp_mul_sub_pi_exp {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∫ l : ℝ, Real.exp (a * l - π * Real.exp l) = π ^ (-a) * Real.Gamma a

name: DedekindResidue.lintegral_Ioi_mellin_scale
statement:
theorem lintegral_Ioi_mellin_scale {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (σ : ℝ) (H : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hH : AEMeasurable H (volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0:ℝ)))) :
    ∫⁻ t in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (σ - 1)) * H (c * t)
      = ENNReal.ofReal (c ^ (-σ))
        * ∫⁻ t in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (σ - 1)) * H t

name: DedekindResidue.lintegral_M0_eq
statement:
theorem lintegral_M0_eq {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    (∫⁻ t in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (σ - 1))
        * ∫⁻ u : logSpace K, ENNReal.ofReal (gaussTerm K t u (embeddingCoords K 1)))
      = (heckeJacobian K : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (∏ w : InfinitePlace K,
          π ^ (-((mult w : ℝ) * σ)) * Real.Gamma ((mult w : ℝ) * σ))

name: DedekindResidue.lintegral_box_theta_tail
statement:
theorem lintegral_box_theta_tail (J : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∫⁻ u in ZSpan.fundamentalDomain ((basisUnitLattice K).ofZLatticeBasis ℝ),
      ENNReal.ofReal
        (heckeTheta K (FractionalIdeal.mk0 K J) (heckeWeights K t u) - 1)
      = ∑' a : idealSet K J, ∫⁻ u : logSpace K,
          ENNReal.ofReal (gaussTerm K t u (embeddingCoords K (conePreimage K J a)))

name: DedekindResidue.lintegral_eq_tsum_box_shift
statement:
theorem lintegral_eq_tsum_box_shift (f : logSpace K → ℝ≥0∞) :
    ∫⁻ u, f u = ∑' n : Fin (rank K) → ℤ,
      ∫⁻ u in ZSpan.fundamentalDomain ((basisUnitLattice K).ofZLatticeBasis ℝ),
        f (u + logEmbedding K (Additive.ofMul (∏ j, fundSystem K j ^ (n j))))

name: DedekindResidue.lintegral_exp_heckeLog
statement:
theorem lintegral_exp_heckeLog (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    ∫⁻ p : ℝ × logSpace K, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (σ * p.1
        - π * ∑ w : InfinitePlace K, Real.exp ((heckeLogCLE K p) w)))
      = (heckeJacobian K : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (∏ w : InfinitePlace K,
          π ^ (-((mult w : ℝ) * σ)) * Real.Gamma ((mult w : ℝ) * σ))

name: DedekindResidue.lintegral_exp_mul_sub_pi_exp
statement:
theorem lintegral_exp_mul_sub_pi_exp {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∫⁻ l : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (a * l - π * Real.exp l))
      = ENNReal.ofReal (π ^ (-a) * Real.Gamma a)

name: DedekindResidue.lintegral_gaussTerm_eq_norm_scaled
statement:
theorem lintegral_gaussTerm_eq_norm_scaled {y : K} (hy : y ≠ 0) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ∫⁻ u : logSpace K, ENNReal.ofReal (gaussTerm K t u (embeddingCoords K y))
      = ∫⁻ u : logSpace K, ENNReal.ofReal
          (gaussTerm K (((|Algebra.norm ℚ y| : ℚ) : ℝ) ^ 2 * t) u
            (embeddingCoords K 1))

name: DedekindResidue.lintegral_mellin_heckeF_dev
statement:
theorem lintegral_mellin_heckeF_dev {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    (∫⁻ t in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (σ - 1))
        * ENNReal.ofReal (heckeF K t - heckeFConst K))
      = ENNReal.ofReal ((heckeBeta K) ^ (-σ))
        * ((heckeJacobian K : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (∏ w : InfinitePlace K,
            π ^ (-((mult w : ℝ) * σ)) * Real.Gamma ((mult w : ℝ) * σ)))
        * ∑' b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰,
            ENNReal.ofReal ((((Ideal.absNorm ((b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : ℝ)) ^ 2)
              ^ (-σ))

name: DedekindResidue.lintegral_mellin_heckeGClass_dev
statement:
theorem lintegral_mellin_heckeGClass_dev (C : ClassGroup (𝓞 K)) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    (∫⁻ t in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (σ - 1))
        * ENNReal.ofReal (heckeGClass K C t - (torsionOrder K : ℝ)⁻¹ * unitBoxVol K))
      = ENNReal.ofReal ((heckeBeta K) ^ (-σ))
        * ((heckeJacobian K : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (∏ w : InfinitePlace K,
            π ^ (-((mult w : ℝ) * σ)) * Real.Gamma ((mult w : ℝ) * σ)))
        * ∑' b : {b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰ //
            ClassGroup.mk0 b = (ClassGroup.mk0 ((ClassGroup.mk0_surjective C).choose))⁻¹},
            ENNReal.ofReal ((((Ideal.absNorm ((b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : ℝ)) ^ 2)
              ^ (-σ))

name: DedekindResidue.lintegral_mellin_heckeG_dev
statement:
theorem lintegral_mellin_heckeG_dev (J : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    (∫⁻ t in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (σ - 1))
        * ENNReal.ofReal (heckeG K (FractionalIdeal.mk0 K J) t
            - (torsionOrder K : ℝ)⁻¹ * unitBoxVol K))
      = ENNReal.ofReal ((torsionOrder K : ℝ)⁻¹)
        * ((heckeJacobian K : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (∏ w : InfinitePlace K,
            π ^ (-((mult w : ℝ) * σ)) * Real.Gamma ((mult w : ℝ) * σ)))
        * ∑' a : idealSet K J, ENNReal.ofReal
            (((((|Algebra.norm ℚ (conePreimage K J a)| : ℚ) : ℝ)) ^ 2) ^ (-σ))

name: DedekindResidue.logEmbedding_prod_fundSystem
statement:
theorem logEmbedding_prod_fundSystem (n : Fin (rank K) → ℤ) :
    logEmbedding K (Additive.ofMul (∏ i, fundSystem K i ^ (n i)))

name: DedekindResidue.map_heckeLogCLE_volume

name: DedekindResidue.mem_idealZLattice_iff_euclidMixed

name: DedekindResidue.normFiber_forget_injective

theorem ofReal_heckeG_sub_const (I : (FractionalIdeal (𝓞 K)⁰ K)ˣ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :

      = ENNReal.ofReal ((torsionOrder K : ℝ)⁻¹)

name: DedekindResidue.prod_pi_rpow_mul_Gamma_nonneg

name: DedekindResidue.setLIntegral_box_swap
statement:
theorem setLIntegral_box_swap (f : logSpace K → ℝ≥0∞)

      ((Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ (unitLattice K)).ofZLatticeBasis ℝ), f u

name: DedekindResidue.sum_placeWeights_unit_smul

statement:
theorem tsum_idealSet_norm_rpow (J : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) (σ : ℝ) :

      ENNReal.ofReal (((((|Algebra.norm ℚ (conePreimage K J a)| : ℚ) : ℝ)) ^ 2) ^ (-σ))
      = (torsionOrder K)
        * ∑' I : {I : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰ // (J : Ideal (𝓞 K)) ∣ (I : Ideal (𝓞 K))
            ∧ Submodule.IsPrincipal ((I : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) : Ideal (𝓞 K))},
            ENNReal.ofReal ((((Ideal.absNorm ((I : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : ℝ)) ^ 2)
              ^ (-σ))

name: DedekindResidue.tsum_ideal_ofReal_eq
statement:
theorem tsum_ideal_ofReal_eq {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 < s) :
    (∑' b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰,

      = ENNReal.ofReal (∑' b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰,
          ((Ideal.absNorm ((b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : ℝ)) ^ (-s))

name: DedekindResidue.tsum_ite_eq_tsum_coneUnfold_ennreal
statement:
theorem tsum_ite_eq_tsum_coneUnfold_ennreal (J : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰)
    (g : EuclideanSpace ℝ (index K) → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑' v : idealZLattice K (FractionalIdeal.mk0 K J),
        if v = 0 then 0 else g (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (index K)))
      = ∑' p : (idealSet K J) × (Fin (rank K) → ℤ),

name: DedekindResidue.tsum_principal_dvd_eq
statement:
theorem tsum_principal_dvd_eq (J : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) (σ : ℝ) :
    (∑' I : {I : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰ // (J : Ideal (𝓞 K)) ∣ (I : Ideal (𝓞 K))
        ∧ Submodule.IsPrincipal ((I : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) : Ideal (𝓞 K))},
        ENNReal.ofReal ((((Ideal.absNorm ((I : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : ℝ)) ^ 2)
          ^ (-σ)))
      = ENNReal.ofReal ((((Ideal.absNorm (J : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : ℝ)) ^ 2) ^ (-σ))
        * ∑' b : {b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰ // ClassGroup.mk0 b = (ClassGroup.mk0 J)⁻¹},
            ENNReal.ofReal ((((Ideal.absNorm ((b : (Ideal (𝓞 K))⁰) : Ideal (𝓞 K)) : ℝ)) ^ 2)
              ^ (-σ))

name: DedekindResidue.le_norm_Gamma_base
statement:
theorem le_norm_Gamma_base {σ t : ℝ} (h1 : 1/2 ≤ σ) (h2 : σ ≤ 3/2) (ht : 1 ≤ |t|) :
    π / (Real.sqrt (12 * π) * ‖((2 - σ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((-t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I‖)
      * Real.exp (-(π * |t|) / 2)
      ≤ ‖Complex.Gamma ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖

    (ht : 1 ≤ |t|) (n : ℕ) :
    π / (Real.sqrt (12 * π) * ‖((2 - σ : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((-t : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I‖)
      * Real.exp (-(π * |t|) / 2)
      ≤ ‖Complex.Gamma (((σ + n : ℝ) : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖

name: DedekindResidue.comparator_bound_left
statement:
theorem comparator_bound_left :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 < M ∧ ∀ t : ℝ,
      ‖completedDedekindZetaEntire K (((-1:ℝ) : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖^4
        * ‖Complex.sin (π * (((-1:ℝ) : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖^(gammaExponent K)
        / ‖(((-1:ℝ) : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) - 4‖^(4 * gammaExponent K + 8)

        * ‖Complex.sin (π * (((2:ℝ) : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I))‖^(gammaExponent K)

name: DedekindResidue.eqOn_of_eventuallyEq_codiscreteWithin
DedekindResidue.exists_H_ball_factorization
statement:
theorem exists_H_ball_factorization (c : ℂ) {R : ℝ}
    {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ Metric.ball c R)
    (hHw : completedDedekindZetaEntire K w ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : ℂ → ℂ, AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (Metric.ball c R)
      ∧ (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c R, g z ≠ 0)
      ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c R,
          completedDedekindZetaEntire K z
            = (∏ᶠ u, (z - u) ^ ((MeromorphicOn.divisor (completedDedekindZetaEntire K)
                (Metric.ball c R)) u)) * g z

name: DedekindResidue.exists_H_ball_sup
statement:
theorem exists_H_ball_sup (A : ℝ) (hA : 2 ≤ A) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ P : ℕ, ∀ T : ℝ, A + 5 ≤ |T| →
      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall ((A : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) (A + 1),
        ‖completedDedekindZetaEntire K z‖
          ≤ C * (1 + |T|)^P
            * Real.exp (-(((gammaExponent K : ℕ) : ℝ) * (π * |T|)) / 4)

name: DedekindResidue.exists_H_ball_sup_big
statement:
theorem exists_H_ball_sup_big (A : ℝ) (hA : 2 ≤ A) :

      ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall ((A : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) (A + 3),
        ‖completedDedekindZetaEntire K z‖
          ≤ C * (1 + |T|)^P
            * Real.exp (-(((gammaExponent K : ℕ) : ℝ) * (π * |T|)) / 4)

name: DedekindResidue.exists_H_center_lower
statement:
theorem exists_H_center_lower :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 2 ≤ A ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ |t| →
      c * Real.exp (-(((gammaExponent K : ℕ) : ℝ) * (π * |t|)) / 4)
        / (1 + |t|)^(nrRealPlaces K + nrComplexPlaces K)
        ≤ ‖completedDedekindZetaEntire K ((A : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖

name: DedekindResidue.exists_H_landau_cofactor
statement:
theorem exists_H_landau_cofactor :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 2 ≤ A ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, A + 5 ≤ |T| →
      ((∑ᶠ u, (MeromorphicOn.divisor (completedDedekindZetaEntire K)
          (Metric.ball ((A : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) (A + 2))) u : ℤ) : ℝ)
        ≤ C * Real.log (2 + |T|) ∧
      ∃ h : ℂ → ℂ,
        AnalyticOnNhd ℂ h (Metric.ball ((A : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) (A + 3))
        ∧ (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((A : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) (A + 2), h z ≠ 0)
        ∧ (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball ((A : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) (A + 3),
            completedDedekindZetaEntire K z
              = (∏ᶠ u, (z - u) ^ ((MeromorphicOn.divisor (completedDedekindZetaEntire K)
                  (Metric.ball ((A : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) (A + 2))) u)) * h z)
        ∧ ∀ s ∈ Metric.closedBall ((A : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) (A + 5/4),
            ‖logDeriv h s‖ ≤ C * Real.log (2 + |T|)

name: DedekindResidue.exists_H_strip_decay

        ≤ C * (1 + |t|)^(nrRealPlaces K + 2 * nrComplexPlaces K + 2)

name: DedekindResidue.exists_H_two_radius_factorization

name: DedekindResidue.exists_H_upper_right
statement:
theorem exists_H_upper_right (σ₁ : ℝ) (hσ₁ : 2 ≤ σ₁) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ P : ℕ, ∀ z : ℂ, 2 ≤ z.re → z.re ≤ σ₁ → 2 ≤ |z.im| →
      ‖completedDedekindZetaEntire K z‖
        ≤ C * (1 + |z.im|)^P
          * Real.exp (-(((gammaExponent K : ℕ) : ℝ) * (π * |z.im|)) / 4)

name: DedekindResidue.exists_ball_zero_count
statement:
theorem exists_ball_zero_count :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 2 ≤ A ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, A + 5 ≤ |T| →
      ((∑ᶠ u, (MeromorphicOn.divisor (completedDedekindZetaEntire K)
          (Metric.closedBall ((A : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) (Real.sqrt (A^2+1)))) u : ℤ)
        : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.log (2 + |T|)

name: DedekindResidue.exists_ball_zero_count_big
statement:
theorem exists_ball_zero_count_big (A : ℝ) (hA2 : 2 ≤ A) (cL : ℝ) (hcL : 0 < cL)
    (hlow : ∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ |t| →
      cL * Real.exp (-(((gammaExponent K : ℕ) : ℝ) * (π * |t|)) / 4)
        / (1 + |t|)^(nrRealPlaces K + nrComplexPlaces K)
        ≤ ‖completedDedekindZetaEntire K ((A : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, A + 5 ≤ |T| →
      ((∑ᶠ u, (MeromorphicOn.divisor (completedDedekindZetaEntire K)
          (Metric.closedBall ((A : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) (A + 2))) u : ℤ)
        : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.log (2 + |T|)

name: DedekindResidue.exists_base_add_nat
statement:
theorem exists_base_add_nat {σ : ℝ} (h : 1/2 ≤ σ) :
    ∃ σ₀ : ℝ, ∃ n : ℕ, 1/2 ≤ σ₀ ∧ σ₀ < 3/2 ∧ σ = σ₀ + n

name: DedekindResidue.exists_completedDedekindZetaEntire_strip_bound
statement:
theorem exists_completedDedekindZetaEntire_strip_bound (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ s : ℂ, a ≤ s.re → s.re ≤ b →
      ‖completedDedekindZetaEntire K s‖ ≤ B * (1 + ‖s‖)^2

name: DedekindResidue.exists_differentiableOn_log
statement:
theorem exists_differentiableOn_log {U : Set ℂ} (hUo : IsOpen U) (hUc : Convex ℝ U)
    (hne : U.Nonempty) {f : ℂ → ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableOn ℂ f U)
    (h0 : ∀ z ∈ U, f z ≠ 0) :
    ∃ L : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ L U ∧ Set.EqOn (Complex.exp ∘ L) f U

name: DedekindResidue.exists_gammaFactor_lower
statement:
theorem exists_gammaFactor_lower (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 1 ≤ σ) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 2 ≤ |t| →
      c * Real.exp (-(((gammaExponent K : ℕ) : ℝ) * (π * |t|)) / 4)
        / (1 + |t|)^(nrRealPlaces K + nrComplexPlaces K)
        ≤ ‖gammaFactor K ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖

name: DedekindResidue.exists_le_norm_Gamma
statement:
theorem exists_le_norm_Gamma (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 1/2 ≤ σ) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ |t| →
      c * Real.exp (-(π * |t|) / 2) / (1 + |t|)
        ≤ ‖Complex.Gamma ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖

name: DedekindResidue.exists_le_norm_Gamma_window
statement:
theorem exists_le_norm_Gamma_window :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ σ t : ℝ, -1 ≤ σ → σ ≤ 2 → 1 ≤ |t| →
      c * Real.exp (-(π * |t|) / 2) / (1 + |t|)^3
        ≤ ‖Complex.Gamma ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖

name: DedekindResidue.exists_logDeriv_partial_fractions
statement:
theorem exists_logDeriv_partial_fractions :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 2 ≤ A ∧ ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ T : ℝ, A + 5 ≤ |T| →
      ((∑ᶠ u, (MeromorphicOn.divisor (completedDedekindZetaEntire K)
          (Metric.ball ((A : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) (A + 2))) u : ℤ) : ℝ)
        ≤ C * Real.log (2 + |T|) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ Metric.closedBall ((A : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) (A + 5/4),
        completedDedekindZetaEntire K s ≠ 0 →
        ‖logDeriv (completedDedekindZetaEntire K) s
            - ∑ᶠ u, (((MeromorphicOn.divisor (completedDedekindZetaEntire K)
                (Metric.ball ((A : ℂ) + (T : ℂ) * Complex.I) (A + 2))) u : ℂ)) / (s - u)‖
          ≤ C * Real.log (2 + |T|)

name: DedekindResidue.exists_norm_Gamma_le
statement:
theorem exists_norm_Gamma_le (σ : ℝ) (hσ : 1/2 ≤ σ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ P : ℕ, ∀ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ |t| →
      ‖Complex.Gamma ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
        ≤ C * (1 + |t|)^P * Real.exp (-(π * |t|) / 2)

name: DedekindResidue.exists_norm_Gamma_le_range
statement:
theorem exists_norm_Gamma_le_range (σ₁ : ℝ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ P : ℕ, ∀ σ t : ℝ, 1/2 ≤ σ → σ ≤ σ₁ → 1 ≤ |t| →
      ‖Complex.Gamma ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
        ≤ C * (1 + |t|)^P * Real.exp (-(π * |t|) / 2)

name: DedekindResidue.exists_norm_Gamma_le_window
statement:
theorem exists_norm_Gamma_le_window :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ P : ℕ, ∀ σ t : ℝ, -2 ≤ σ → σ ≤ 3 → 1 ≤ |t| →
      ‖Complex.Gamma ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
        ≤ C * (1 + |t|)^P * Real.exp (-(π * |t|) / 2)

name: DedekindResidue.exists_norm_digamma_le
statement:
theorem exists_norm_digamma_le :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ σ t : ℝ, -1 ≤ σ → σ ≤ 2 → 2 ≤ |t| →
      ‖Complex.digamma ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C * Real.log (2 + |t|)

name: DedekindResidue.exists_norm_gammaFactor_le_range
statement:
theorem exists_norm_gammaFactor_le_range (σ₁ : ℝ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ P : ℕ, ∀ σ t : ℝ, 1 ≤ σ → σ ≤ σ₁ → 2 ≤ |t| →
      ‖gammaFactor K ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
        ≤ C * (1 + |t|)^P
          * Real.exp (-(((gammaExponent K : ℕ) : ℝ) * (π * |t|)) / 4)

name: DedekindResidue.exists_re_norm_dedekindZeta_ge_half
statement:
theorem exists_re_norm_dedekindZeta_ge_half :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 2 ≤ A ∧ ∀ s : ℂ, A ≤ s.re → 1/2 ≤ ‖dedekindZeta K s‖

name: DedekindResidue.exp_neg_pi_abs_half_div_two
statement:
theorem exp_neg_pi_abs_half_div_two (t : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-(π * |t/2|) / 2) = Real.exp (-(π * |t|) / 4)

name: DedekindResidue.norm_Gamma_eq_norm_Gamma_add_one_div
statement:
theorem norm_Gamma_eq_norm_Gamma_add_one_div {z : ℂ} (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    ‖Complex.Gamma z‖ = ‖Complex.Gamma (z + 1)‖ / ‖z‖

name: DedekindResidue.norm_Gamma_le_mul_exp_add_nat
statement:
theorem norm_Gamma_le_mul_exp_add_nat {σ t : ℝ} (h1 : 1/2 ≤ σ) (h2 : σ ≤ 3/2)
    (ht : 1 ≤ |t|) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖Complex.Gamma (((σ + n : ℝ) : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
      ≤ (‖(σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ + n)^n
        * (Real.sqrt (12 * π) * ‖(σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I‖
          * Real.exp (-(π * |t|) / 2))

name: DedekindResidue.norm_dedekindZeta_le_of_two_le_re
statement:
theorem norm_dedekindZeta_le_of_two_le_re {s : ℂ} (hs : 2 ≤ s.re) :
    ‖dedekindZeta K s‖
      ≤ ∑' n : ℕ, ‖LSeries.term
          (fun n => (Nat.card {I : Ideal (𝓞 K) // Ideal.absNorm I = n} : ℂ)) 2 n‖

name: DedekindResidue.norm_gammaFactor_le
statement:
theorem norm_gammaFactor_le {σ t : ℝ} (h1 : 1 ≤ σ) (h2 : σ ≤ 2) (ht : 2 ≤ |t|) :
    ‖gammaFactor K ((σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
      ≤ (Real.sqrt (12*π))^(nrRealPlaces K) * (8 * Real.sqrt (12*π))^(nrComplexPlaces K)
        * (1 + |t|)^(nrRealPlaces K + 2 * nrComplexPlaces K)
        * Real.exp (-(((nrRealPlaces K + 2 * nrComplexPlaces K : ℕ) : ℝ) * (π * |t|)) / 4)

name: DedekindResidue.norm_logDeriv_le_of_norm_le
statement:
theorem norm_logDeriv_le_of_norm_le {h : ℂ → ℂ} {c : ℂ} {r : ℝ} (hr : 3/4 < r)
    (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ h (Metric.ball c r))
    (h0 : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c r, h z ≠ 0)
    {mS mL : ℝ} (hmL : 0 < mL) (hcL : mL ≤ ‖h c‖)
    (hS : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c r, ‖h z‖ ≤ mS) :
    ∀ s ∈ Metric.closedBall c (r - 3/4),
      ‖logDeriv h s‖ ≤ 32 * r * (Real.log (mS/mL) + 1)

name: DedekindResidue.norm_ofReal_add_mul_I_le
statement:
theorem norm_ofReal_add_mul_I_le (σ t : ℝ) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) :
    ‖(σ : ℂ) + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I‖ ≤ σ + |t|

name: DedekindResidue.one_add_abs_im_le_two_norm_sub_four
statement:
theorem one_add_abs_im_le_two_norm_sub_four {z : ℂ} (_h1 : -1 ≤ z.re) (h2 : z.re ≤ 2) :
    1 + |z.im| ≤ 2 * ‖z - 4‖

name: DedekindResidue.boundedVariationOn_Ici_of_piecewise_deriv
statement:
theorem boundedVariationOn_Ici_of_piecewise_deriv {f f' : ℝ → ℂ} {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hcont : ContinuousOn f (Set.Ici a))
    (hd1 : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    (hd2 : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioi b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    (hint : IntegrableOn f' (Set.Ici a)) :
    BoundedVariationOn f (Set.Ici a)

name: DedekindResidue.boundedVariationOn_of_deriv_integrable
statement:
theorem boundedVariationOn_of_deriv_integrable {f f' : ℝ → ℂ} {s : Set ℝ}
    (hs : s.OrdConnected) (hcont : ContinuousOn f s)
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ interior s, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    (hint : IntegrableOn f' s) :
    BoundedVariationOn f s

name: DedekindResidue.eVariationOn_le_integral_norm_deriv
statement:
theorem eVariationOn_le_integral_norm_deriv {f f' : ℝ → ℂ} {s : Set ℝ}
    (hs : s.OrdConnected) (hcont : ContinuousOn f s)
    (hderiv : ∀ x ∈ interior s, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x)
    (hint : IntegrableOn f' s) :
    eVariationOn f s ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in s, ‖f' x‖)

name: DedekindResidue.auxF_of_gt
statement:
theorem auxF_of_gt (s : ℂ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 < X) {t : ℝ} (ht : Real.log X < t) :
    auxF s X t
      = (Real.log X : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((s - 1/2) * (Real.log X : ℂ))
          * (Complex.exp (-(s - 1/2) * t) / t)

name: DedekindResidue.fourier_auxF
statement:
theorem fourier_auxF (s : ℂ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 < X) (hs : 1/2 < s.re) {γ : ℝ}
    (hγ : γ ≠ 0) :
    paperFourierIntegral (auxF s X) γ
      = 2 * (s - 1/2)^2 / (((s - 1/2)^2 + (γ:ℂ)^2) * γ)
          * ((Real.sin (Real.log X * γ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        + 2 * ((s - 1/2) + 1/(Real.log X : ℂ)) / ((s - 1/2)^2 + (γ:ℂ)^2)
          * ((Real.cos (Real.log X * γ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        - 4 / ((s - 1/2)^2 + (γ:ℂ)^2) * ∫ t in Set.Ioi (Real.log X),
            ((Real.cos (t * γ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * auxF s X t * (((s - 1/2)*t + 1)/t^2)

name: DedekindResidue.fourier_auxF_zero
statement:
theorem fourier_auxF_zero (s : ℂ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 < X) (hs : 1/2 < s.re) :
    paperFourierIntegral (auxF s X) 0
      = 2 * (Real.log X : ℂ)
        + 2 * ((s - 1/2) + 1/(Real.log X : ℂ)) / (s - 1/2)^2
        - 4 / (s - 1/2)^2 * ∫ t in Set.Ioi (Real.log X),
            auxF s X t * (((s - 1/2)*t + 1)/t^2)

name: DedekindResidue.hasDerivAt_gAux_core
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_gAux_core (h : ℂ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-h * u) / u)
      (-(h + 1/t) * (Complex.exp (-h * t) / t)) t

name: DedekindResidue.hasDerivAt_gAux_deriv
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_gAux_deriv (h : ℂ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => -(h + 1/u) * (Complex.exp (-h * u) / u))
      ((h^2 + (2*h*t + 2)/t^2) * (Complex.exp (-h * t) / t)) t

name: DedekindResidue.integrableOn_bounded_mul_exp_div
statement:
theorem integrableOn_bounded_mul_exp_div {h : ℂ} (hh : 0 < h.re) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    {φ : ℝ → ℂ} (hφc : ContinuousOn φ (Set.Ioi T)) {C : ℝ}
    (hφb : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioi T, ‖φ t‖ ≤ C) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => φ t * (Complex.exp (-h * t) / t)) (Set.Ioi T)

name: DedekindResidue.integrableOn_exp_div_mul_real
statement:
theorem integrableOn_exp_div_mul_real {h : ℂ} (hh : 0 < h.re) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    {ψ : ℝ → ℝ} (hψc : Continuous ψ) {C : ℝ} (hψb : ∀ t, |ψ t| ≤ C) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => Complex.exp (-h * t) / t * ((ψ t : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (Set.Ioi T)

name: DedekindResidue.integrableOn_gAux_deriv2_mul_real
statement:
theorem integrableOn_gAux_deriv2_mul_real {h : ℂ} (hh : 0 < h.re) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    {ψ : ℝ → ℝ} (hψc : Continuous ψ) {C : ℝ} (hψb : ∀ t, |ψ t| ≤ C) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ =>
      (h^2 + (2*h*t + 2)/t^2) * (Complex.exp (-h * t) / t) * ((ψ t : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (Set.Ioi T)

name: DedekindResidue.integrableOn_gAux_deriv_mul_real
statement:
theorem integrableOn_gAux_deriv_mul_real {h : ℂ} (hh : 0 < h.re) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    {ψ : ℝ → ℝ} (hψc : Continuous ψ) {C : ℝ} (hψb : ∀ t, |ψ t| ≤ C) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ =>
      -(h + 1/t) * (Complex.exp (-h * t) / t) * ((ψ t : ℝ) : ℂ)) (Set.Ioi T)

name: DedekindResidue.integrableOn_gAux_mul_affine_div_sq
statement:
theorem integrableOn_gAux_mul_affine_div_sq {h : ℂ} (hh : 0 < h.re) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ =>
      (Complex.exp (-h * t) / t) * ((h*t + 1)/t^2)) (Set.Ioi T)

name: DedekindResidue.integrable_auxF_kernel
statement:
theorem integrable_auxF_kernel (s : ℂ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 ≤ X) (hs : 1/2 < s.re) (γ : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => auxF s X t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * t * γ))

name: DedekindResidue.integrable_exp_neg_mul_abs
statement:
theorem integrable_exp_neg_mul_abs {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    Integrable (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp (-b * |t|))

name: DedekindResidue.integral_Ioi_gAux_deriv2
statement:
theorem integral_Ioi_gAux_deriv2 {h : ℂ} (hh : 0 < h.re) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∫ t in Set.Ioi T, (h^2 + (2*h*t + 2)/t^2) * (Complex.exp (-h * t) / t))
      = (h + 1/(T:ℂ)) * (Complex.exp (-h * (T:ℂ)) / (T:ℂ))

name: DedekindResidue.integral_Ioi_gAux_deriv2_split
statement:
theorem integral_Ioi_gAux_deriv2_split {h : ℂ} (hh : 0 < h.re) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) :
    (∫ t in Set.Ioi T, (h^2 + (2*h*t + 2)/t^2) * (Complex.exp (-h * t) / t))
      = h^2 * (∫ t in Set.Ioi T, Complex.exp (-h * t) / t)
        + 2 * ∫ t in Set.Ioi T, (Complex.exp (-h * t) / t) * ((h*t + 1)/t^2)

name: DedekindResidue.integral_plateau_cos
statement:
theorem integral_plateau_cos {T γ : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) :
    (∫ t in Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) T, ((Real.cos (t * γ) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      = ((Real.sin (T * γ) / γ : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: DedekindResidue.norm_affine_div_sq_le
statement:
theorem norm_affine_div_sq_le (h : ℂ) {t T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : T ≤ t) :
    ‖(h * (t : ℂ) + 1) / (t : ℂ) ^ 2‖ ≤ ‖h‖ / T + 1 / T ^ 2

name: DedekindResidue.norm_affine_inv_le
statement:
theorem norm_affine_inv_le (h : ℂ) {t T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) (ht : T ≤ t) :
    ‖h + 1 / (t : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖h‖ + 1 / T

name: DedekindResidue.norm_auxF_le
statement:
theorem norm_auxF_le (s : ℂ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 ≤ X) (hs : 1/2 ≤ s.re) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖auxF s X t‖ ≤ Real.exp ((s.re - 1/2) * Real.log X)
      * Real.exp (-(s.re - 1/2) * |t|)

name: DedekindResidue.paperFourierIntegral_even
statement:
theorem paperFourierIntegral_even (F : ℝ → ℂ) (hF : ∀ t, F (-t) = F t) (γ : ℝ)
    (hInt : Integrable (fun t : ℝ => F t * Complex.exp (Complex.I * t * γ))) :
    paperFourierIntegral F γ
      = 2 * ∫ t in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), F t * ((Real.cos (t * γ) : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: DedekindResidue.tail_integral_identity
statement:
theorem tail_integral_identity (h : ℂ) (hh : 0 < h.re) {T γ : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hγ : γ ≠ 0) :
    (h^2 + γ^2) * ∫ t in Set.Ioi T,
        Complex.exp (-h * t) / t * ((Real.cos (t * γ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      = -γ * (Complex.exp (-h * T) / T) * ((Real.sin (T * γ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        + (h + 1/T) * (Complex.exp (-h * T) / T) * ((Real.cos (T * γ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        - 2 * ∫ t in Set.Ioi T,
            ((Real.cos (t * γ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (-h * t) / t)
              * ((h*t + 1)/t^2)

name: DedekindResidue.tendsto_exp_div_mul_atTop
DedekindResidue.auxF_diffQuot_bv
statement:
theorem auxF_diffQuot_bv (hX : 1 < X) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    BoundedVariationOn (fun x : ℝ => (1 - auxF s X x) / (x : ℂ)) (Set.Ici 0)

name: DedekindResidue.auxF_diffQuot_tail_eq
statement:
theorem auxF_diffQuot_tail_eq (hX : 1 < X) :
    ∀ x ∈ Set.Ici (Real.log X),
      (1 - auxF s X x) / (x : ℂ)
        = 1/(x:ℂ) - ((Real.log X : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((s - 1/2) * (Real.log X : ℂ))
            * Complex.exp (-(s - 1/2) * x) / (x:ℂ)^2

name: DedekindResidue.auxF_eq_max
statement:
theorem auxF_eq_max (s : ℂ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 < X) (t : ℝ) :
    auxF s X t
      = ((Real.log X / max |t| (Real.log X) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        * Complex.exp (-(s - 1/2) * ((max |t| (Real.log X) - Real.log X : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: DedekindResidue.auxF_jump_avg
statement:
theorem auxF_jump_avg (s : ℂ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 < X) (x : ℝ) :
    ∃ L R : ℂ,
      Filter.Tendsto (auxF s X) (nhdsWithin x (Set.Iio x)) (nhds L)
      ∧ Filter.Tendsto (auxF s X) (nhdsWithin x (Set.Ioi x)) (nhds R)
      ∧ auxF s X x = (L + R) / 2

name: DedekindResidue.auxF_mul_exp_bv
statement:
theorem auxF_mul_exp_bv (hX : 1 < X) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    BoundedVariationOn
      (fun x : ℝ => auxF s X x * ((Real.exp ((1/2 + (s.re - 1)/2) * x) : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (Set.Ici 0)

name: DedekindResidue.auxF_mul_exp_bv_Ici
statement:

theorem exists_H_rectangle_factorization {a b c d : ℝ}
    {w : ℂ} (hw : w ∈ Set.Ioo a b ×ℂ Set.Ioo c d)
    (hHw : completedDedekindZetaEntire K w ≠ 0) :

      ∧ (∀ z ∈ Set.Ioo a b ×ℂ Set.Ioo c d, g z ≠ 0)
      ∧ ∀ z ∈ Set.Ioo a b ×ℂ Set.Ioo c d,
          completedDedekindZetaEntire K z

name: DedekindResidue.exists_contour_height
statement:
theorem exists_contour_height :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 2 ≤ A ∧ ∃ c C : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ c ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∀ T₀ : ℝ, A + 5 ≤ T₀ →
      ∃ T ∈ Set.Icc T₀ (T₀ + 1),
        (∀ ρ : ℂ, completedDedekindZetaEntire K ρ = 0 →
          c / Real.log (2 + T₀) ≤ |T - ρ.im| ∧ c / Real.log (2 + T₀) ≤ |T + ρ.im|)
        ∧ (∀ σ : ℝ, -(1/4) ≤ σ → σ ≤ 5/4 →
            completedDedekindZetaEntire K ((σ:ℂ) + (T:ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0
            ∧ ‖logDeriv (completedDedekindZetaEntire K) ((σ:ℂ) + (T:ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
              ≤ C * (Real.log (2 + T₀))^2)
        ∧ ∀ σ : ℝ, -(1/4) ≤ σ → σ ≤ 5/4 →
            completedDedekindZetaEntire K ((σ:ℂ) + ((-T:ℝ):ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0
            ∧ ‖logDeriv (completedDedekindZetaEntire K) ((σ:ℂ) + ((-T:ℝ):ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
              ≤ C * (Real.log (2 + T₀))^2

statement:
theorem rectangleIntegral_fold_vertical {a T : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hT : 0 < T)
    {Φ : ℂ → ℂ} (hΦc : ContinuousOn Φ (Set.uIcc (-a) (1+a) ×ℂ Set.uIcc (-T) T)) :
    rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => Φ ζ * logDeriv (completedDedekindZetaEntire K) ζ)
        (((-a : ℝ):ℂ) + ((-T:ℝ):ℂ) * Complex.I) (((1+a : ℝ):ℂ) + ((T:ℝ):ℂ) * Complex.I)
      = (∫ x : ℝ in (-a)..(1+a),
            Φ ((x:ℂ) + ((-T:ℝ):ℂ) * Complex.I)
              * logDeriv (completedDedekindZetaEntire K) ((x:ℂ) + ((-T:ℝ):ℂ) * Complex.I))
        - (∫ x : ℝ in (-a)..(1+a),
            Φ ((x:ℂ) + ((T:ℝ):ℂ) * Complex.I)
              * logDeriv (completedDedekindZetaEntire K) ((x:ℂ) + ((T:ℝ):ℂ) * Complex.I))
        + Complex.I • ∫ y : ℝ in (-T)..T,
            (Φ (((1+a:ℝ):ℂ) + (y:ℂ) * Complex.I)
              + Φ (1 - (((1+a:ℝ):ℂ) + (y:ℂ) * Complex.I)))
              * logDeriv (completedDedekindZetaEntire K)

statement:
theorem rectangleIntegral_mul_logDeriv_H {z w : ℂ} (hre : z.re < w.re) (him : z.im < w.im)
    {Φ : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hΦ : ∀ ζ ∈ Set.uIcc z.re w.re ×ℂ Set.uIcc z.im w.im, DifferentiableAt ℂ Φ ζ)

    (hHw₀ : completedDedekindZetaEntire K w₀ ≠ 0) :
    rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => Φ ζ * logDeriv (completedDedekindZetaEntire K) ζ) z w
      = 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I
        * ∑ᶠ ρ, (((MeromorphicOn.divisor (completedDedekindZetaEntire K)

statement:

    (hΦ : ∀ ζ ∈ Set.uIcc (-a) (1+a) ×ℂ Set.uIcc (-T) T, DifferentiableAt ℂ Φ ζ)
    (htop : ∀ σ : ℝ, -a ≤ σ → σ ≤ 1+a →

    (hbot : ∀ σ : ℝ, -a ≤ σ → σ ≤ 1+a →
      completedDedekindZetaEntire K ((σ:ℂ) + ((-T:ℝ):ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0) :
    rectangleIntegral (fun ζ => Φ ζ * logDeriv (completedDedekindZetaEntire K) ζ)
        (((-a : ℝ):ℂ) + ((-T:ℝ):ℂ) * Complex.I) (((1+a : ℝ):ℂ) + ((T:ℝ):ℂ) * Complex.I)
      = 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I
        * ∑ᶠ ρ, (((MeromorphicOn.divisor (completedDedekindZetaEntire K)
            (Set.Ioo (-a) (1+a) ×ℂ Set.Ioo (-T) T)) ρ : ℂ)) * Φ ρ

name: DedekindResidue.zero_capture_edge_form
statement:
theorem zero_capture_edge_form {a T : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha' : a ≤ 1/4) (hT : 0 < T)
    {Φ : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hΦ : ∀ ζ ∈ Set.uIcc (-a) (1+a) ×ℂ Set.uIcc (-T) T, DifferentiableAt ℂ Φ ζ)
    (htop : ∀ σ : ℝ, -a ≤ σ → σ ≤ 1+a →
      completedDedekindZetaEntire K ((σ:ℂ) + (T:ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0)
    (hbot : ∀ σ : ℝ, -a ≤ σ → σ ≤ 1+a →
      completedDedekindZetaEntire K ((σ:ℂ) + ((-T:ℝ):ℂ) * Complex.I) ≠ 0)
    {CΦ Cl : ℝ} (hCΦ0 : 0 ≤ CΦ)
    (hΦtop : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (-a) (1+a), ‖Φ ((x:ℂ) + (T:ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ CΦ)
    (hΦbot : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (-a) (1+a), ‖Φ ((x:ℂ) + ((-T:ℝ):ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ CΦ)
    (hltop : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (-a) (1+a),
      ‖logDeriv (completedDedekindZetaEntire K) ((x:ℂ) + (T:ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Cl)
    (hlbot : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc (-a) (1+a),
      ‖logDeriv (completedDedekindZetaEntire K) ((x:ℂ) + ((-T:ℝ):ℂ) * Complex.I)‖ ≤ Cl) :
    ‖2 * Real.pi * Complex.I
        * ∑ᶠ ρ, (((MeromorphicOn.divisor (completedDedekindZetaEntire K)
            (Set.Ioo (-a) (1+a) ×ℂ Set.Ioo (-T) T)) ρ : ℂ)) * Φ ρ
      - Complex.I • ∫ y : ℝ in (-T)..T,
          (Φ (((1+a:ℝ):ℂ) + (y:ℂ) * Complex.I)
            + Φ (1 - (((1+a:ℝ):ℂ) + (y:ℂ) * Complex.I)))
            * logDeriv (completedDedekindZetaEntire K)
                (((1+a:ℝ):ℂ) + (y:ℂ) * Complex.I)‖
      ≤ 2 * (1 + 2*a) * (CΦ * Cl)

name: DedekindResidue.norm_integral_sub_rightLim_kernel_le
statement:
theorem norm_integral_sub_rightLim_kernel_le
    {p q r s : ℝ → ℝ} (hp : Monotone p) (hq : Monotone q)
    (hr : Monotone r) (hs : Monotone s) {H : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hre : ∀ u, (H u).re = p u - q u) (him : ∀ u, (H u).im = r u - s u)
    {Hp : ℂ} (hHpre : Hp.re = Function.rightLim p 0 - Function.rightLim q 0)
    (hHpim : Hp.im = Function.rightLim r 0 - Function.rightLim s 0)
    {C T δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hHint : IntegrableOn H (Set.Ioc 0 δ))
    (hwin : ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) δ, |∫ u in v..δ, 2 * Real.sin (T * u) / u| ≤ C) :
    ‖∫ u in (0:ℝ)..δ, (H u - Hp) * ((2 * Real.sin (T * u) / u : ℝ) : ℂ)‖
      ≤ C * ((Function.rightLim p δ - Function.rightLim p 0)
            + (Function.rightLim q δ - Function.rightLim q 0))
        + C * ((Function.rightLim r δ - Function.rightLim r 0)
            + (Function.rightLim s δ - Function.rightLim s 0))

    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {F : ℝ → ℂ}
    (hFeven : ∀ x : ℝ, F (-x) = F x)
    (hFa : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => F x * ((Real.exp ((1/2+a) * x) : ℝ) : ℂ)))
    (hHre : LocallyBoundedVariationOn (fun u => (primeSideH K a F u).re) Set.univ)
    (hHim : LocallyBoundedVariationOn (fun u => (primeSideH K a F u).im) Set.univ)
    {Hp Hm : ℂ}
    (hHp : Tendsto (primeSideH K a F) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds Hp))
    (hHm : Tendsto (primeSideH K a F) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Iio 0)) (nhds Hm)) :
    Tendsto (fun T : ℝ => ∫ t in (-T)..T,
        (paperPhi F (((1+a : ℝ):ℂ) + (t:ℂ)*Complex.I)
          + paperPhi F (1 - (((1+a : ℝ):ℂ) + (t:ℂ)*Complex.I)))
          * (-(logDeriv (NumberField.dedekindZeta K) (((1+a : ℝ):ℂ) + (t:ℂ)*Complex.I))))
      atTop (nhds (2 * ((π : ℝ) : ℂ) * (Hp + Hm)))

theorem integral_half_line_fold (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]

theorem integral_rhoFT_mul_phi_eq {k F : ℝ → ℂ} (hk : Integrable k) (hF : Integrable F)

statement:
theorem prop3_poitou {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) {F : ℝ → ℂ} (hF : Integrable F)
    (hFeven : ∀ x : ℝ, F (-x) = F x)
    (hFdiv : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => (F 0 - F x)/(x:ℂ)) (Set.Ioc (-1) 1))
    (hFdiv2 : MemLp (fun x : ℝ => (F 0 - F x)/(x:ℂ)) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (htop : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ =>
      rhoFT (fun x => ((poitouKernel σ x : ℝ) : ℂ)) t * gammaFT F t) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hbot : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ =>
      rhoFT (fun x => ((poitouKernel σ x : ℝ) : ℂ)) t * gammaFT F t) atBot (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun T : ℝ => ∫ t in (-T)..T,

            - Complex.digamma (σ:ℂ)).re) : ℝ)) : ℂ)
          * (∫ x : ℝ, F x * Complex.exp ((t*x : ℝ) * Complex.I)))
      atTop (nhds (((4*π : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ y in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),

statement:
theorem tendsto_IG_gammaFactor (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]
    {F : ℝ → ℂ} (hF : Integrable F)
    (hre : LocallyBoundedVariationOn (fun u : ℝ => (F u).re) Set.univ)
    (him : LocallyBoundedVariationOn (fun u : ℝ => (F u).im) Set.univ)
    (hF0 : Tendsto F (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (F 0)))
    (hFeven : ∀ x : ℝ, F (-x) = F x)
    (hFdiv : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => (F 0 - F x)/(x:ℂ)) (Set.Ioc (-1) 1))
    (hFdiv2 : MemLp (fun x : ℝ => (F 0 - F x)/(x:ℂ)) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    (htop2 : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ =>
      rhoFT (fun x => ((poitouKernel (1/2) x : ℝ) : ℂ)) t * gammaFT F t) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hbot2 : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ =>
      rhoFT (fun x => ((poitouKernel (1/2) x : ℝ) : ℂ)) t * gammaFT F t) atBot (nhds 0))
    (htop4 : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ =>
      rhoFT (fun x => ((poitouKernel (1/4) x : ℝ) : ℂ)) t
        * gammaFT (fun x : ℝ => F (x/2) / 2) t) atTop (nhds 0))
    (hbot4 : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ =>
      rhoFT (fun x => ((poitouKernel (1/4) x : ℝ) : ℂ)) t
        * gammaFT (fun x : ℝ => F (x/2) / 2) t) atBot (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun T : ℝ => ∫ t in (-T)..T,
        ((2 * (logDeriv (gammaFactor K) (((1/2:ℝ):ℂ) + (t:ℂ)*Complex.I)).re : ℝ) : ℂ)
          * (∫ x : ℝ, F x * Complex.exp ((t*x : ℝ) * Complex.I)))
      atTop (nhds (((2*π : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ((((-(((NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K : ℝ)
              + 2*(NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K : ℝ))
                * (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant + Real.log (8*π))
              + (NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K : ℝ) * (π/2)) : ℝ)) : ℂ) * F 0
          + (((NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K
              + 2*NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K : ℕ)) : ℂ)
              * (∫ y in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),
                ((1/(2 * Real.sinh (y/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (F 0 - F y))
          + ((NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K : ℕ) : ℂ)
              * ∫ y in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),

    (hbot : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => rhoFT k t * gammaFT F t) atBot (nhds 0)) :

theorem tendsto_shift_vertical_sub {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {Φ g : ℂ → ℂ}

    (hg : ∀ s : ℂ, 0 < s.re → DifferentiableAt ℂ g s)
    {B C : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ σ t : ℝ, -a ≤ σ → σ ≤ 1+a → ‖Φ ((σ:ℂ) + (t:ℂ)*Complex.I)‖ ≤ B |t|)
    (hgb : ∀ σ t : ℝ, 1/2 ≤ σ → σ ≤ 1+a → 4 ≤ |t| →
      ‖g ((σ:ℂ) + (t:ℂ)*Complex.I)‖ ≤ C |t|)
    (hlim : Tendsto (fun T : ℝ => B T * C T) atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun T : ℝ =>
      (∫ y in (-T)..T, (Φ (((1+a:ℝ):ℂ) + (y:ℂ)*Complex.I)
          + Φ (1 - (((1+a:ℝ):ℂ) + (y:ℂ)*Complex.I)))
          * g (((1+a:ℝ):ℂ) + (y:ℂ)*Complex.I))
      - ∫ y in (-T)..T, (Φ (((1/2:ℝ):ℂ) + (y:ℂ)*Complex.I)
          + Φ (1 - (((1/2:ℝ):ℂ) + (y:ℂ)*Complex.I)))
          * g (((1/2:ℝ):ℂ) + (y:ℂ)*Complex.I)) atTop (nhds 0)

name: DedekindResidue.two_re_logDeriv_gammaFactor_half
statement:
theorem two_re_logDeriv_gammaFactor_half (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (t : ℝ) :
    2 * (logDeriv (gammaFactor K) (((1/2:ℝ):ℂ) + (t:ℂ)*Complex.I)).re
      = -((((NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K : ℝ)
            + 2*(NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K : ℝ))
              * (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant + Real.log (8*π))
          + (NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K : ℝ) * (π/2)))
        + ((NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K : ℝ)/2)
            * (2 * ((Complex.digamma (((1/4:ℝ):ℂ) + ((t/2:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I)
                - Complex.digamma ((1/4:ℝ):ℂ)).re))
        + (NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K : ℝ)
            * (2 * ((Complex.digamma (((1/2:ℝ):ℂ) + (t:ℂ)*Complex.I)
                - Complex.digamma ((1/2:ℝ):ℂ)).re))

name: DedekindResidue.tendsto_boundary_auxF
statement:

theorem finite_plateau_support {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 < X) :
    {pk : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥} × ℕ |
      (((pk.2+1 : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1) ≤ Real.log X}.Finite

name: DedekindResidue.integrableOn_auxF_tail_kernel
statement:
theorem integrableOn_auxF_tail_kernel (s : ℂ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 < X) (hs : 1/2 < s.re)
    (γ : ℝ) :
    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ =>
        ((Real.cos (t * γ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * auxF s X t * (((s - 1/2)*t + 1)/t^2))
      (Set.Ioi (Real.log X))

name: DedekindResidue.lemma3_display
statement:
theorem lemma3_display (hGRH : GeneralizedRiemannHypothesis K)
    {σ X : ℝ} (hσ : 1 < σ) (hX : 1 < X) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha' : a ≤ 1/4)
    (has : a < σ - 1) :
    2 * ((Real.log X * Real.exp ((σ - 1/2) * Real.log X)
        * Real.log ((NumberField.dedekindZeta K (σ:ℂ)).re) : ℝ) : ℂ)
      = (paperPhi (auxF (σ:ℂ) X) 0 + paperPhi (auxF (σ:ℂ) X) 1)
        + ((Real.log |NumberField.discr K| : ℝ) : ℂ)
        + (((-(((NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K : ℝ)
            + 2*(NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K : ℝ))
              * (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant + Real.log (8*π))
            + (NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K : ℝ) * (π/2)) : ℝ)) : ℂ)
        + (((NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K
            + 2*NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K : ℕ)) : ℂ)
            * (∫ y in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),
              ((1/(2 * Real.sinh (y/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (1 - auxF (σ:ℂ) X y))
        + ((NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K : ℕ) : ℂ)
            * (∫ y in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),
              ((1/(2 * Real.cosh (y/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (1 - auxF (σ:ℂ) X y))
        - 2 * ((∑' pk : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥} × ℕ,
            (if (((pk.2+1 : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1) ≤ Real.log X
              then Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1)
                * (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1 : ℝ) ^ (-(((pk.2+1 : ℕ)) : ℝ) / 2)
                * (1 - Real.log X
                    / (((pk.2+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1))
                    * Real.exp (-(σ - 1/2)
                        * (((pk.2+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1)
                          - Real.log X)))
              else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        - (∑' ρ : ZetaZeros K, (zetaZeroDivisor K ρ.1 : ℂ) * zeroSinTerm (σ:ℂ) X ρ.1.im)
        - (∑' ρ : ZetaZeros K, (zetaZeroDivisor K ρ.1 : ℂ) * zeroCosTerm (σ:ℂ) X ρ.1.im)
        + ∑' ρ : ZetaZeros K,
            (zetaZeroDivisor K ρ.1 : ℂ) * zeroIntTerm (σ:ℂ) X ρ.1.im

name: DedekindResidue.norm_zeroCosTerm_le
statement:
theorem norm_zeroCosTerm_le {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1/2 < σ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 < X) (γ : ℝ) :
    ‖zeroCosTerm (σ:ℂ) X γ‖
      ≤ 2*((σ - 1/2) + 1/Real.log X) / ((σ - 1/2)^2 + γ^2)

name: DedekindResidue.norm_zeroIntTerm_le
statement:
theorem norm_zeroIntTerm_le {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1/2 < σ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 < X) (γ : ℝ) :
    ‖zeroIntTerm (σ:ℂ) X γ‖
      ≤ 4 * auxFTailNormBound σ X / ((σ - 1/2)^2 + γ^2)

name: DedekindResidue.norm_zeroSinTerm_le
statement:
theorem norm_zeroSinTerm_le {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1/2 < σ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 < X) (γ : ℝ) :
    ‖zeroSinTerm (σ:ℂ) X γ‖
      ≤ 2*(σ - 1/2)^2 * Real.log X / ((σ - 1/2)^2 + γ^2)

name: DedekindResidue.paperFourierIntegral_auxF_split
statement:
theorem paperFourierIntegral_auxF_split (s : ℂ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 < X)
    (hs : 1/2 < s.re) (γ : ℝ) :
    paperFourierIntegral (auxF s X) γ
      = zeroSinTerm s X γ + zeroCosTerm s X γ - zeroIntTerm s X γ

name: DedekindResidue.primeSideH_auxF_zero_split
statement:
theorem primeSideH_auxF_zero_split (a : ℝ) {σ X : ℝ} (hσ : 1 < σ) (hX : 1 < X) :
    primeSideH K a (auxF (σ:ℂ) X) 0
      = ((∑' pk : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥} × ℕ,
          (if (((pk.2+1 : ℕ)) : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1) ≤ Real.log X
            then Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1)
              * (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1 : ℝ) ^ (-(((pk.2+1 : ℕ)) : ℝ) / 2)
              * (1 - Real.log X / (((pk.2+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1))
                  * Real.exp (-(σ - 1/2)
                      * (((pk.2+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1)
                        - Real.log X)))
            else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ)
        + ((Real.log X * Real.exp ((σ - 1/2) * Real.log X)
            * Real.log ((NumberField.dedekindZeta K (σ:ℂ)).re) : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: DedekindResidue.summable_kernel
statement:
theorem summable_kernel {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1 < σ) (X : ℝ) :
    Summable (fun pk : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥} × ℕ =>
      Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1)
        * (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1 : ℝ) ^ (-(((pk.2+1 : ℕ)) : ℝ) / 2)
        * (Real.log X / (((pk.2+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1))
            * Real.exp (-(σ - 1/2)
                * (((pk.2+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1) - Real.log X))))

name: DedekindResidue.summable_zetaZeros_mul_of_norm_le
DedekindResidue.summable_zetaZeros_paperPhi_auxF
statement:
theorem summable_zetaZeros_paperPhi_auxF (hGRH : GeneralizedRiemannHypothesis K)
    (s : ℂ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 < X) (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    Summable (fun ρ : ZetaZeros K =>

name: DedekindResidue.tsum_kernel_eq_log_zeta
statement:
theorem tsum_kernel_eq_log_zeta {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1 < σ) (X : ℝ) :
    ∑' pk : {𝔭 : Ideal (𝓞 K) // 𝔭.IsPrime ∧ 𝔭 ≠ ⊥} × ℕ,
      Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1)
        * (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1 : ℝ) ^ (-(((pk.2+1 : ℕ)) : ℝ) / 2)
        * (Real.log X / (((pk.2+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1))
            * Real.exp (-(σ - 1/2)
                * (((pk.2+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log (Ideal.absNorm pk.1.1) - Real.log X)))
      = Real.log X * Real.exp ((σ - 1/2) * Real.log X)
          * Real.log ((NumberField.dedekindZeta K (σ:ℂ)).re)

name: DedekindResidue.tsum_zetaZeros_paperPhi_auxF_eq
statement:
theorem tsum_zetaZeros_paperPhi_auxF_eq (hGRH : GeneralizedRiemannHypothesis K)
    (s : ℂ) {X : ℝ} (hX : 1 < X) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (ha' : a ≤ 1/4)
    (has : a < s.re - 1) :
    ∑' ρ : ZetaZeros K, (zetaZeroDivisor K ρ.1 : ℂ) * paperPhi (auxF s X) ρ.1
      = (paperPhi (auxF s X) 0 + paperPhi (auxF s X) 1)
          + ((Real.log |NumberField.discr K| : ℝ) : ℂ) * auxF s X 0
          + (((-(((NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K : ℝ)
              + 2*(NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K : ℝ))
                * (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant + Real.log (8*π))
              + (NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K : ℝ) * (π/2)) : ℝ)) : ℂ)
              * auxF s X 0
          + (((NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K
              + 2*NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K : ℕ)) : ℂ)
              * (∫ y in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),
                ((1/(2 * Real.sinh (y/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (auxF s X 0 - auxF s X y))
          + ((NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K : ℕ) : ℂ)
              * (∫ y in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),
                ((1/(2 * Real.cosh (y/2)) : ℝ) : ℂ) * (auxF s X 0 - auxF s X y))
          - (primeSideH K a (auxF s X) 0 + primeSideH K a (auxF s X) 0)

name: DedekindResidue.tsum_zetaZeros_paperPhi_auxF_split
statement:
theorem tsum_zetaZeros_paperPhi_auxF_split (hGRH : GeneralizedRiemannHypothesis K)
    {σ X : ℝ} (hσ : 1 < σ) (hX : 1 < X) :
    ∑' ρ : ZetaZeros K, (zetaZeroDivisor K ρ.1 : ℂ) * paperPhi (auxF (σ:ℂ) X) ρ.1
      = (∑' ρ : ZetaZeros K, (zetaZeroDivisor K ρ.1 : ℂ) * zeroSinTerm (σ:ℂ) X ρ.1.im)
        + (∑' ρ : ZetaZeros K, (zetaZeroDivisor K ρ.1 : ℂ) * zeroCosTerm (σ:ℂ) X ρ.1.im)
        - ∑' ρ : ZetaZeros K, (zetaZeroDivisor K ρ.1 : ℂ) * zeroIntTerm (σ:ℂ) X ρ.1.im

    |((NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K : ℝ)

name: DedekindResidue.integral_archWeight_mul_cutKernel_Ioi_zero
statement:
theorem integral_archWeight_mul_cutKernel_Ioi_zero {σ : ℝ} (hσ1 : 1 ≤ σ) {U : ℝ}
    (hU : 0 < U) :
    ∫ y in Set.Ioi 0, archWeight y * cutKernel σ y U
      = ∫ y in Set.Ioi U, archWeight y * cutKernel σ y U

name: DedekindResidue.integral_archWeight_sub_split
statement:
theorem integral_archWeight_sub_split {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 1/2 < σ) {T' T : ℝ}
    (hT' : 0 < T') (hT : 0 < T) :
    ∫ y in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ), archWeight y * (auxFCut σ T y - auxFCut σ T' y)
      = (∫ y in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),
          1/(2 * Real.sinh (y/2)) * (auxFCut σ T y - auxFCut σ T' y))
        + ∫ y in Set.Ioi (0:ℝ),
          1/(2 * Real.cosh (y/2)) * (auxFCut σ T y - auxFCut σ T' y)
